CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."assignment_escalation_materialize_due"("p_limit" integer) RETURNS integer
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE inserted_count integer;
BEGIN
  IF NOT pg_has_role(session_user,''epm_worker'',''member'') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''ASSIGNMENT_ESCALATION_WORKER_REQUIRED'';
  END IF;
  IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit<1 OR p_limit>1000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''ASSIGNMENT_ESCALATION_MATERIALIZE_LIMIT_INVALID''
      USING ERRCODE=''22023'';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtextextended(''epm.assignment.escalation.materialize'',0));
  WITH due AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.workspace_id,s.application_id,
      s.active_assignment_set_id assignment_set_id,
      s.active_version assignment_version,a->>''assignmentId'' assignment_id,
      (a->>''dueAt'')::timestamptz due_at
    FROM epm.planning_assignment_state s
    JOIN epm.planning_assignment_version v
      ON v.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND v.application_id=s.application_id
     AND v.assignment_set_id=s.active_assignment_set_id
     AND v.version=s.active_version
    JOIN epm.planning_workflow_policy_state ps
      ON ps.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND ps.application_id=s.application_id
     AND ps.active_policy_id=v.policy_id AND ps.active_version=v.policy_version
    JOIN epm.planning_workflow_policy_version pv
      ON pv.workspace_id=ps.workspace_id AND pv.application_id=ps.application_id
     AND pv.policy_id=ps.active_policy_id AND pv.version=ps.active_version
     AND pv.canonical_digest=v.policy_digest
    JOIN epm.workspace w ON w.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND w.status=''Active''
    JOIN epm.application app
      ON app.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND app.application_id=s.application_id
     AND app.status=''Active''
    JOIN epm.application_state ast
      ON ast.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND ast.application_id=s.application_id
     AND ast.processing_mode=''Active''
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(v.definition->''assignments'') a
    WHERE s.active_assignment_set_id IS NOT NULL
      AND jsonb_typeof(a)=''object''
      AND a->>''assignmentId'' IS NOT NULL
      AND a->>''dueAt'' IS NOT NULL
      AND jsonb_typeof(a->''escalation'')=''object''
      AND (a->''escalation''->>''afterDueMinutes'') IS NOT NULL
      AND clock_timestamp()>=(a->>''dueAt'')::timestamptz+
        ((a->''escalation''->>''afterDueMinutes'')::integer*interval ''1 minute'')
      AND (v.definition->>''effectiveFrom'' IS NULL OR
           clock_timestamp()>=(v.definition->>''effectiveFrom'')::timestamptz)
      AND (v.definition->>''effectiveTo'' IS NULL OR
           clock_timestamp()<=(v.definition->>''effectiveTo'')::timestamptz)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM epm.planning_assignment_due_occurrence existing
        WHERE existing.workspace_id=s.workspace_id
          AND existing.application_id=s.application_id
          AND existing.assignment_set_id=s.active_assignment_set_id
          AND existing.assignment_version=s.active_version
          AND existing.assignment_id=a->>''assignmentId''
          AND existing.due_at=(a->>''dueAt'')::timestamptz)
    ORDER BY (a->>''dueAt'')::timestamptz,s.workspace_id,s.application_id,
      a->>''assignmentId''
    LIMIT p_limit
  )
  INSERT INTO epm.planning_assignment_due_occurrence(
    workspace_id,application_id,assignment_set_id,assignment_version,
    assignment_id,due_at,status)
  SELECT workspace_id,application_id,assignment_set_id,assignment_version,
    assignment_id,due_at,''Pending'' FROM due
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS inserted_count=ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN inserted_count;
END ';
ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."assignment_escalation_materialize_due"("p_limit" integer) OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."assignment_escalation_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer) RETURNS TABLE("workspace_id" "text", "application_id" "text", "assignment_set_id" "text", "assignment_version" bigint, "assignment_id" "text", "due_at" timestamp with time zone, "claim_generation" bigint)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE c record;
BEGIN
 IF NOT pg_has_role(session_user,''epm_worker'',''member'') OR
    p_claimant!~''^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]*$'' OR
    length(p_claimant)>300 OR p_lease_seconds<5 OR p_lease_seconds>300 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION ''ASSIGNMENT_ESCALATION_WORKER_ARGUMENT_INVALID'';
 END IF;
 SELECT q.* INTO c FROM (
   SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.workspace_id,o.application_id)
     o.workspace_id,o.application_id,o.assignment_set_id,o.assignment_version,
     o.assignment_id,o.due_at,o.claim_generation
   FROM epm.planning_assignment_due_occurrence o
   JOIN epm.workspace w ON w.workspace_id=o.workspace_id AND w.status=''Active''
   JOIN epm.application a ON a.workspace_id=o.workspace_id
    AND a.application_id=o.application_id AND a.status=''Active''
   JOIN epm.application_state ast ON ast.workspace_id=o.workspace_id
    AND ast.application_id=o.application_id AND ast.processing_mode=''Active''
   WHERE o.status=''Pending'' OR
     (o.status=''Running'' AND o.lease_until<clock_timestamp())
   ORDER BY o.workspace_id,o.application_id,o.due_at,o.assignment_id
 ) q ORDER BY q.due_at,q.workspace_id,q.application_id LIMIT 1;
 IF c IS NULL THEN RETURN;END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(c.workspace_id,0));
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
   hashtextextended(c.workspace_id||chr(31)||c.application_id,0));
 RETURN QUERY UPDATE epm.planning_assignment_due_occurrence o
 SET status=''Running'',claim_generation=o.claim_generation+1,
   claimant=p_claimant,
   lease_until=clock_timestamp()+p_lease_seconds*interval ''1 second''
 WHERE o.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND o.application_id=c.application_id
  AND o.assignment_set_id=c.assignment_set_id
  AND o.assignment_version=c.assignment_version
  AND o.assignment_id=c.assignment_id AND o.due_at=c.due_at
  AND (o.status=''Pending'' OR
       (o.status=''Running'' AND o.lease_until<clock_timestamp()))
 RETURNING o.workspace_id,o.application_id,o.assignment_set_id,
   o.assignment_version,o.assignment_id,o.due_at,o.claim_generation;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."coordinate_project_inserted"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E' BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coordinate_inserted c JOIN epm.layout_replacement_activation x USING(workspace_id,application_id)
  WHERE x.status=''Activating'' AND epm.layout_replacement_activation_allowed(c.workspace_id,c.application_id,x.target_projection_generation)) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM epm.application_state s JOIN(SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id,application_id FROM coordinate_inserted)c USING(workspace_id,application_id)
  ORDER BY s.workspace_id,s.application_id FOR UPDATE OF s;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coordinate_inserted c JOIN epm.application_state s USING(workspace_id,application_id)
  JOIN epm.coordinate_layout l USING(workspace_id,application_id,schema_epoch)
  WHERE ARRAY(SELECT key FROM jsonb_object_keys(c.members)keys(key) ORDER BY key COLLATE "C")<>l.dimensions) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''COORDINATE_LAYOUT_GRAIN_MISMATCH'';END IF;
 INSERT INTO epm.coordinate_projection_state(projection_generation,workspace_id,application_id,coordinate_id,schema_epoch,
  entity_member,account_member,scenario_member,year_member,period_member,value_member,view_member,icp_member,data_type_member,custom_members)
 SELECT s.active_projection_generation,c.workspace_id,c.application_id,c.coordinate_id,l.schema_epoch,
 c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Entity''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Account''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Scenario''),
 c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Year''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Period''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Value''),
 c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''View''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''ICP''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''DataType''),
 ARRAY(SELECT c.members->>axis FROM unnest(l.custom_dimensions) WITH ORDINALITY z(axis,pos) ORDER BY pos)
 FROM coordinate_inserted c JOIN epm.application_state s USING(workspace_id,application_id)
 JOIN epm.coordinate_layout l USING(workspace_id,application_id,schema_epoch);RETURN NULL;END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."coordinate_projection_build"("w" "text", "a" "text") RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
BEGIN
    PERFORM 1 FROM epm.application_state WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a FOR UPDATE;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.coordinate c JOIN epm.application_state s USING(workspace_id,application_id)
        JOIN epm.coordinate_layout l USING(workspace_id,application_id,schema_epoch)
        WHERE c.workspace_id=w AND c.application_id=a
        AND ARRAY(SELECT key FROM jsonb_object_keys(c.members) keys(key) ORDER BY key COLLATE "C")<>l.dimensions) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''COORDINATE_LAYOUT_GRAIN_MISMATCH'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO epm.coordinate_projection_state(projection_generation,workspace_id,application_id,coordinate_id,schema_epoch,
        entity_member,account_member,scenario_member,year_member,period_member,value_member,view_member,icp_member,data_type_member,custom_members)
    SELECT s.active_projection_generation,c.workspace_id,c.application_id,c.coordinate_id,l.schema_epoch,
        c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Entity''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Account''),
        c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Scenario''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Year''),
        c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Period''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''Value''),
        c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''View''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''ICP''),c.members->>(l.role_dimensions->>''DataType''),
        ARRAY(SELECT c.members->>axis FROM unnest(l.custom_dimensions) WITH ORDINALITY axes(axis,position) ORDER BY position)
    FROM epm.coordinate c JOIN epm.application_state s USING(workspace_id,application_id)
    JOIN epm.coordinate_layout l USING(workspace_id,application_id,schema_epoch)
    WHERE c.workspace_id=w AND c.application_id=a
    ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,application_id,projection_generation,coordinate_id) DO UPDATE SET
        schema_epoch=excluded.schema_epoch,entity_member=excluded.entity_member,account_member=excluded.account_member,
        scenario_member=excluded.scenario_member,year_member=excluded.year_member,period_member=excluded.period_member,
        value_member=excluded.value_member,view_member=excluded.view_member,icp_member=excluded.icp_member,
        data_type_member=excluded.data_type_member,custom_members=excluded.custom_members;
END ';
ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."coordinate_projection_build"("w" "text", "a" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."coordinate_series_key"("members" "jsonb") RETURNS "text"
    LANGUAGE "sql" IMMUTABLE STRICT
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
    SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(''['' || string_agg(
        ''['' || to_json(axis)::text || '','' || to_json(member)::text || '']'',
        '','' ORDER BY axis COLLATE "C") || '']'', ''UTF8'')), ''hex'')

';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."cube_aggregate_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer, "p_global_limit" integer, "p_workspace_limit" integer, "p_application_limit" integer) RETURNS TABLE("workspace_id" "text", "application_id" "text", "query_id" "text", "issuer" "text", "subject_id" "text", "status" "text", "claim_generation" bigint, "normalized_request" "jsonb")
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE candidate record;
BEGIN
  IF p_claimant IS NULL OR length(p_claimant) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
     OR p_lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 300
     OR p_global_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000
     OR p_workspace_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p_global_limit
     OR p_application_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p_workspace_limit THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''CUBE_AGGREGATE_WORKER_CLAIM_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023'';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(''epm.cube.aggregate.dispatch'',0));
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.cube_aggregate_query running_query
      WHERE running_query.status=''running'')>=p_global_limit THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  SELECT q.* INTO candidate FROM epm.cube_aggregate_query q
    JOIN epm.application a USING(workspace_id,application_id)
    JOIN epm.application_state s USING(workspace_id,application_id)
    JOIN epm.workspace w USING(workspace_id)
    LEFT JOIN epm.worker_workspace_dispatch d ON d.workspace_id=q.workspace_id
    WHERE q.status IN (''computed'',''ready'') AND q.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
      AND a.status=''Active'' AND w.status=''Active'' AND s.processing_mode=''Active''
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.cube_aggregate_query active
           WHERE active.workspace_id=q.workspace_id AND active.status=''running'')<p_workspace_limit
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.cube_aggregate_query active
           WHERE active.workspace_id=q.workspace_id AND active.application_id=q.application_id
             AND active.status=''running'')<p_application_limit
    ORDER BY (q.status=''computed'') DESC,d.last_claim_sequence NULLS FIRST,
      q.accepted_at,q.query_id FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
  IF candidate.status=''ready'' THEN
    UPDATE epm.cube_aggregate_query q SET status=''running'',
      claim_generation=q.claim_generation+1,claimant=p_claimant,
      lease_until=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>p_lease_seconds),
      attempts=q.attempts+1,updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
    WHERE q.workspace_id=candidate.workspace_id AND q.application_id=candidate.application_id
      AND q.query_id=candidate.query_id;
    candidate.status:=''running''; candidate.claim_generation:=candidate.claim_generation+1;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO epm.worker_workspace_dispatch(workspace_id,last_claim_sequence,claim_count)
    VALUES(candidate.workspace_id,nextval(''epm.worker_dispatch_sequence''),1)
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT worker_workspace_dispatch_pkey DO UPDATE SET
      last_claim_sequence=EXCLUDED.last_claim_sequence,
      claim_count=epm.worker_workspace_dispatch.claim_count+1;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT candidate.workspace_id,candidate.application_id,
    candidate.query_id,candidate.issuer,candidate.subject_id,candidate.status,
    candidate.claim_generation,candidate.normalized_request;
END ';

ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."cube_aggregate_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer, "p_global_limit" integer, "p_workspace_limit" integer, "p_application_limit" integer) OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."cube_aggregate_worker_expire"("p_limit" integer, "p_payload_retention_seconds" integer) RETURNS TABLE("expired_count" integer, "payload_query_count" integer)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE expired_rows integer:=0; payload_queries integer:=0;
BEGIN
  IF p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
     OR p_payload_retention_seconds NOT BETWEEN 60 AND 604800 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''CUBE_AGGREGATE_EXPIRY_POLICY_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023'';
  END IF;
  WITH due AS (
    SELECT q.workspace_id,q.application_id,q.query_id
      FROM epm.cube_aggregate_query q
     WHERE q.status=''sealed'' AND q.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
     ORDER BY q.expires_at,q.workspace_id,q.application_id,q.query_id
     FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED LIMIT p_limit
  )
  UPDATE epm.cube_aggregate_query q SET status=''expired'',
    updated_at=transaction_timestamp() FROM due
   WHERE q.workspace_id=due.workspace_id
     AND q.application_id=due.application_id AND q.query_id=due.query_id;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS expired_rows=ROW_COUNT;
  WITH due AS (
    SELECT q.workspace_id,q.application_id,q.query_id
      FROM epm.cube_aggregate_query q
     WHERE q.status=''expired''
       AND q.updated_at<=clock_timestamp()
          -make_interval(secs=>p_payload_retention_seconds)
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epm.cube_aggregate_result r
          WHERE r.workspace_id=q.workspace_id
            AND r.application_id=q.application_id AND r.query_id=q.query_id)
     ORDER BY q.updated_at,q.workspace_id,q.application_id,q.query_id
     FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED LIMIT p_limit
  ), deleted AS (
    DELETE FROM epm.cube_aggregate_result r USING due
     WHERE r.workspace_id=due.workspace_id
       AND r.application_id=due.application_id AND r.query_id=due.query_id
    RETURNING r.workspace_id,r.application_id,r.query_id
  )
  SELECT count(*)::integer INTO payload_queries FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id,application_id,query_id FROM deleted) removed;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT expired_rows,payload_queries;
END ';
ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."cube_aggregate_worker_expire"("p_limit" integer, "p_payload_retention_seconds" integer) OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."execution_delegation_is_current"("p_workspace" "text", "p_application" "text", "p_delegation" "text", "p_version" bigint, "p_issuer" "text", "p_subject" "text", "p_operation" "text", "p_schedule" "text", "p_schedule_version" bigint) RETURNS boolean

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."export_producer_publish_complete"("w" "text", "a" "text", "rid" "text", "who" "text", "generation" bigint, "artifact" "text", "manifest_digest" "text", "payload_digest" "text") RETURNS boolean
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE r epm.fact_export_producer_request%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO r FROM epm.fact_export_producer_request
  WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a AND request_id=rid FOR UPDATE;
 IF r.status=''Completed'' THEN
  IF r.artifact_id IS DISTINCT FROM artifact
   OR r.manifest->>''manifestDigest'' IS DISTINCT FROM manifest_digest
   OR r.payload_digest IS DISTINCT FROM payload_digest THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION ''EXPORT_PRODUCER_COMPLETE_CONFLICT'';END IF;
  RETURN true;
 END IF;
 IF r.status<>''Publishing'' OR r.claimant<>who
  OR r.claim_generation<>generation OR r.lease_until<=clock_timestamp()
  OR r.cancel_requested THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''EXPORT_PRODUCER_STALE_WORKER'';END IF;
 IF r.manifest->>''manifestDigest'' IS DISTINCT FROM manifest_digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''EXPORT_PRODUCER_DURABLE_IDENTITY_DRIFT'';END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.fact_export_artifact x
  JOIN epm.fact_export_payload p USING(workspace_id,application_id,artifact_id)
  LEFT JOIN epm.fact_export_producer_request owner
   ON owner.workspace_id=x.workspace_id AND owner.application_id=x.application_id
   AND owner.request_id=x.producer_request_id
  WHERE x.workspace_id=w AND x.application_id=a AND x.artifact_id=artifact
   AND x.manifest_digest=manifest_digest AND p.status=''complete''
   AND p.payload_digest=payload_digest
   AND x.retention_status=''retained'' AND p.retention_status=''retained''
   AND x.expires_at_epoch>extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint
   AND p.expires_at_epoch>extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint AND(
    (x.producer_request_id=rid AND x.producer_claim_generation=generation) OR
    x.producer_request_id IS NULL OR
    (owner.status=''Completed'' AND owner.artifact_id=x.artifact_id
     AND owner.payload_digest=p.payload_digest)) FOR UPDATE OF x,p) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''EXPORT_PRODUCER_PAYLOAD_INCOMPLETE'';END IF;
 UPDATE epm.fact_export_producer_request SET status=''Completed'',
  artifact_id=artifact,claimant=NULL,lease_until=NULL,
  payload_digest=payload_digest,published_at=clock_timestamp(),
  updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
 WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a AND request_id=rid
  AND status=''Publishing'' AND claimant=who AND claim_generation=generation
  AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND NOT cancel_requested;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''EXPORT_PRODUCER_STALE_WORKER'';END IF;
 RETURN true;
END';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."fact_detail_delete_matches"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_deleted d WHERE NOT
        epm.projection_cleanup_allowed(d.workspace_id,d.application_id,d.projection_generation,''detail'')) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
    \x2d- Reset deletes history before projections under its existing privileged
    \x2d- manifest workflow. Runtime cannot delete immutable detail history.
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_deleted c JOIN LATERAL(
        SELECT * FROM epm.line_detail_event e WHERE e.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND e.application_id=c.application_id
          AND e.coordinate_id=c.coordinate_id ORDER BY committed_revision DESC LIMIT 1)e ON true
        LEFT JOIN epm.operation_receipt r ON r.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND r.application_id=e.application_id AND r.operation_id=e.operation_id
        WHERE e.present OR (coalesce(r.sealed,true) AND NOT epm.fact_reconstruction_allowed(c.workspace_id,c.application_id))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_DETAIL_PROJECTION_INCONSISTENT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."fact_event_open"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_inserted i JOIN epm.operation_receipt r
        USING(workspace_id,application_id,operation_id) WHERE r.sealed) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_OPERATION_SEALED'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_inserted i JOIN epm.operation_receipt r
        USING(workspace_id,application_id,operation_id) WHERE i.committed_revision<>r.committed_revision) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_EVENT_REVISION_MISMATCH'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME=''numeric_fact_event'' THEN
        IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_inserted i LEFT JOIN LATERAL(
            SELECT resulting_amount FROM epm.numeric_fact_event p WHERE p.workspace_id=i.workspace_id
              AND p.application_id=i.application_id AND p.coordinate_id=i.coordinate_id
              AND ROW(p.committed_revision,p.line_ordinal)<ROW(i.committed_revision,i.line_ordinal)
              ORDER BY committed_revision DESC,line_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1)p ON true
            WHERE i.present<>(i.kind<>''clear'') OR i.delta<>coalesce(i.resulting_amount,0)-coalesce(p.resulting_amount,0)) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_NUMERIC_LINEAGE_INCONSISTENT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
        END IF;
    ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME=''text_fact_event'' THEN
        IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_inserted i LEFT JOIN LATERAL(
            SELECT present,resulting_value FROM epm.text_fact_event p WHERE p.workspace_id=i.workspace_id
              AND p.application_id=i.application_id AND p.coordinate_id=i.coordinate_id
              AND ROW(p.committed_revision,p.line_ordinal)<ROW(i.committed_revision,i.line_ordinal)
              ORDER BY committed_revision DESC,line_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1)p ON true
            WHERE i.present<>(i.kind<>''clear'') OR i.prior_present<>coalesce(p.present,false)
              OR i.prior_value IS DISTINCT FROM p.resulting_value) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_TEXT_LINEAGE_INCONSISTENT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_inserted i LEFT JOIN LATERAL(
            SELECT present,items,total FROM epm.line_detail_event p WHERE p.workspace_id=i.workspace_id
              AND p.application_id=i.application_id AND p.coordinate_id=i.coordinate_id
              AND p.committed_revision<i.committed_revision ORDER BY committed_revision DESC LIMIT 1)p ON true
            WHERE i.prior_items IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN p.present THEN p.items ELSE NULL END
              OR i.prior_total IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN p.present THEN p.total ELSE NULL END
              OR i.total<>(SELECT coalesce(sum((x->>''amount'')::numeric),0) FROM jsonb_array_elements(i.items)x)) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_DETAIL_LINEAGE_INCONSISTENT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END ';
ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."fact_event_open"() OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."fact_projection_matches"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E' BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_projected c WHERE NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM epm.layout_replacement_activation x WHERE x.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND x.application_id=c.application_id
   AND x.target_projection_generation=c.projection_generation AND x.status=''Activating''
   AND epm.layout_replacement_activation_allowed(c.workspace_id,c.application_id,c.projection_generation))) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME=''numeric_cell_projection'' THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_projected c LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT * FROM epm.numeric_fact_event e WHERE e.workspace_id=c.workspace_id
   AND e.application_id=c.application_id AND e.coordinate_id=c.coordinate_id ORDER BY committed_revision DESC,line_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1)e ON true
   LEFT JOIN epm.operation_receipt r ON r.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND r.application_id=e.application_id AND r.operation_id=e.operation_id
   WHERE e.event_id IS NULL OR(coalesce(r.sealed,true)AND NOT epm.fact_reconstruction_allowed(c.workspace_id,c.application_id))
   OR ROW(c.present,c.amount,c.change_id,c.last_revision)IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(e.present,e.resulting_amount,e.change_id,e.committed_revision))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_PROJECTION_INCONSISTENT'';END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME=''text_cell_projection'' THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_projected c LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT * FROM epm.text_fact_event e WHERE e.workspace_id=c.workspace_id
   AND e.application_id=c.application_id AND e.coordinate_id=c.coordinate_id ORDER BY committed_revision DESC,line_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1)e ON true
   LEFT JOIN epm.operation_receipt r ON r.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND r.application_id=e.application_id AND r.operation_id=e.operation_id
   WHERE e.event_id IS NULL OR(coalesce(r.sealed,true)AND NOT epm.fact_reconstruction_allowed(c.workspace_id,c.application_id))
   OR ROW(c.present,c.text_value,c.change_id,c.last_revision)IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(e.present,e.resulting_value,e.change_id,e.committed_revision))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_PROJECTION_INCONSISTENT'';END IF;
 ELSE
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_projected c LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT * FROM epm.line_detail_event e WHERE e.workspace_id=c.workspace_id
   AND e.application_id=c.application_id AND e.coordinate_id=c.coordinate_id ORDER BY committed_revision DESC LIMIT 1)e ON true
   LEFT JOIN epm.operation_receipt r ON r.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND r.application_id=e.application_id AND r.operation_id=e.operation_id
   WHERE e.event_id IS NULL OR(coalesce(r.sealed,true)AND NOT epm.fact_reconstruction_allowed(c.workspace_id,c.application_id))
   OR NOT e.present OR ROW(c.items,c.total,c.change_id,c.last_revision)IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(e.items,e.total,e.change_id,e.committed_revision))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_DETAIL_PROJECTION_INCONSISTENT'';END IF;
 END IF;RETURN NULL;END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."fact_reconcile"("w" "text", "a" "text", "op" "text") RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
BEGIN
    PERFORM epm.fact_scope_check(w,a);
    \x2d- Every original predicate below is rooted in one of the three raw event
    \x2d- sets represented by this transactionally maintained membership key.
    \x2d- No membership is the exact empty-operation proof. Nonempty operations
    \x2d- retain every original validation, and late inserts still meet the
    \x2d- original sealed-receipt/event guards before their transaction commits.
    IF NOT epm.raw_operation_membership_exists(w,a,op) THEN RETURN; END IF;
    IF EXISTS(WITH touched AS (SELECT DISTINCT coordinate_id FROM epm.numeric_fact_event
         WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a AND operation_id=op)
       SELECT 1 FROM touched i LEFT JOIN epm.numeric_cell_current c
         ON c.workspace_id=w AND c.application_id=a AND c.coordinate_id=i.coordinate_id
       LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT present,resulting_amount,change_id,committed_revision FROM epm.numeric_fact_event
         WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a AND coordinate_id=i.coordinate_id
         ORDER BY committed_revision DESC,line_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1)e ON true
       WHERE c.coordinate_id IS NULL OR ROW(c.present,c.amount,c.change_id,c.last_revision)
         IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(e.present,e.resulting_amount,e.change_id,e.committed_revision)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_PROJECTION_INCONSISTENT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.numeric_fact_event e
       JOIN epm.line_detail_current d USING(workspace_id,application_id,coordinate_id)
       JOIN epm.numeric_cell_current n USING(workspace_id,application_id,coordinate_id)
       WHERE e.workspace_id=w AND e.application_id=a AND e.operation_id=op
         AND (NOT n.present OR n.amount<>d.total)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_DETAIL_PROJECTION_INCONSISTENT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(WITH touched AS (SELECT DISTINCT coordinate_id FROM epm.text_fact_event
         WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a AND operation_id=op)
       SELECT 1 FROM touched i LEFT JOIN epm.text_cell_current c
         ON c.workspace_id=w AND c.application_id=a AND c.coordinate_id=i.coordinate_id
       LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT present,resulting_value,change_id,committed_revision FROM epm.text_fact_event
         WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a AND coordinate_id=i.coordinate_id
         ORDER BY committed_revision DESC,line_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1)e ON true
       WHERE c.coordinate_id IS NULL OR ROW(c.present,c.text_value,c.change_id,c.last_revision)
         IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(e.present,e.resulting_value,e.change_id,e.committed_revision)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_PROJECTION_INCONSISTENT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(WITH touched AS (SELECT DISTINCT coordinate_id FROM epm.line_detail_event
         WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a AND operation_id=op)
       SELECT 1 FROM touched i LEFT JOIN epm.line_detail_current c
         ON c.workspace_id=w AND c.application_id=a AND c.coordinate_id=i.coordinate_id
       LEFT JOIN epm.numeric_cell_current n ON n.workspace_id=w AND n.application_id=a AND n.coordinate_id=i.coordinate_id
       LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT present,items,total,change_id,committed_revision FROM epm.line_detail_event
         WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a AND coordinate_id=i.coordinate_id
         ORDER BY committed_revision DESC LIMIT 1)e ON true
       WHERE (e.present AND (c.coordinate_id IS NULL OR ROW(c.items,c.total,c.change_id,c.last_revision)
           IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(e.items,e.total,e.change_id,e.committed_revision) OR NOT coalesce(n.present,false) OR n.amount<>e.total))
         OR (NOT e.present AND c.coordinate_id IS NOT NULL)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_DETAIL_PROJECTION_INCONSISTENT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."fact_reconstruction_allowed"("w" "text", "a" "text") RETURNS boolean
    LANGUAGE "sql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
    SELECT CASE WHEN pg_has_role(current_user,(SELECT relowner FROM pg_class
        WHERE oid=''epm.operation_receipt''::regclass),''USAGE'') THEN
        coalesce(current_setting(''epm.fact_reconstruction_context'',true)=
            jsonb_build_array(w,a,pg_current_xact_id()::text,pg_backend_pid())::text,false)
        ELSE false END
';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."fact_reconstruction_validate"("w" "text", "a" "text", "head" bigint) RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (
        SELECT workspace_id,application_id,operation_id,committed_revision FROM epm.numeric_fact_event
        WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a
        UNION ALL SELECT workspace_id,application_id,operation_id,committed_revision FROM epm.text_fact_event
        WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a
        UNION ALL SELECT workspace_id,application_id,operation_id,committed_revision FROM epm.line_detail_event
        WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a
        UNION ALL SELECT workspace_id,application_id,operation_id,committed_revision FROM epm.generic_fact_event
        WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a)e
        LEFT JOIN epm.operation_receipt r USING(workspace_id,application_id,operation_id)
        WHERE r.operation_id IS NULL OR NOT r.sealed OR e.committed_revision<>r.committed_revision
          OR e.committed_revision>head)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.generic_fact_event e JOIN epm.operation_receipt r
          USING(workspace_id,application_id,operation_id) WHERE e.workspace_id=w AND e.application_id=a
          AND e.actor_id<>r.actor_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RECONSTRUCTION_RECEIPT_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(WITH h AS (SELECT *,lag(resulting_amount) OVER chain AS previous_amount
        FROM epm.numeric_fact_event WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a
        WINDOW chain AS(PARTITION BY coordinate_id ORDER BY committed_revision,line_ordinal))
        SELECT 1 FROM h WHERE present IS DISTINCT FROM (kind<>''clear'')
          OR delta IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(resulting_amount,0)-coalesce(previous_amount,0)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RECONSTRUCTION_NUMERIC_LINEAGE_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(WITH h AS (SELECT *,lag(present) OVER chain AS previous_present,
          lag(resulting_value) OVER chain AS previous_value FROM epm.text_fact_event
        WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a
        WINDOW chain AS(PARTITION BY coordinate_id ORDER BY committed_revision,line_ordinal))
        SELECT 1 FROM h WHERE present IS DISTINCT FROM (kind<>''clear'')
          OR prior_present IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(previous_present,false)
          OR prior_value IS DISTINCT FROM previous_value) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RECONSTRUCTION_TEXT_LINEAGE_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(WITH h AS (SELECT *,lag(present) OVER chain AS previous_present,
          lag(items) OVER chain AS previous_items,lag(total) OVER chain AS previous_total
        FROM epm.line_detail_event WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a
        WINDOW chain AS(PARTITION BY coordinate_id ORDER BY committed_revision))
        SELECT 1 FROM h WHERE prior_items IS DISTINCT FROM
            CASE WHEN previous_present THEN previous_items ELSE NULL END
          OR prior_total IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN previous_present THEN previous_total ELSE NULL END
          OR total IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT coalesce(sum((x->>''amount'')::numeric),0)
              FROM jsonb_array_elements(items)x)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RECONSTRUCTION_DETAIL_LINEAGE_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(WITH h AS (SELECT *,lag(action) OVER chain AS previous_action,
          lag(after_value) OVER chain AS previous_value,lag(resulting_change_id) OVER chain AS previous_id
        FROM epm.generic_fact_event WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a
        WINDOW chain AS(PARTITION BY table_id,series_key ORDER BY committed_revision))
        SELECT 1 FROM h WHERE before_value IS DISTINCT FROM
            CASE WHEN previous_action<>''Delete'' THEN previous_value ELSE NULL END
          OR before_change_id IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN previous_action<>''Delete'' THEN previous_id ELSE '''' END
          OR (action=''Create'') IS DISTINCT FROM (previous_action IS NULL OR previous_action=''Delete'')
          OR resulting_change_id!~''^[0-9a-f]{32}$''
          OR (action=''Delete'' AND after_value IS NOT NULL)
          OR (action<>''Delete'' AND (after_value IS NULL OR after_value=''null''::jsonb))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RECONSTRUCTION_GENERIC_LINEAGE_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(WITH n AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(coordinate_id) coordinate_id,present FROM epm.numeric_fact_event
          WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a ORDER BY coordinate_id,committed_revision DESC,line_ordinal DESC),
        t AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(coordinate_id) coordinate_id,present FROM epm.text_fact_event
          WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a ORDER BY coordinate_id,committed_revision DESC,line_ordinal DESC)
        SELECT 1 FROM n JOIN t USING(coordinate_id) WHERE n.present AND t.present) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RECONSTRUCTION_VALUE_TYPE_CONFLICT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.line_detail_event d LEFT JOIN LATERAL(
        SELECT present,resulting_amount FROM epm.numeric_fact_event n
        WHERE n.workspace_id=d.workspace_id AND n.application_id=d.application_id AND n.coordinate_id=d.coordinate_id
          AND n.committed_revision<=d.committed_revision
        ORDER BY n.committed_revision DESC,n.line_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1)n ON true
        WHERE d.workspace_id=w AND d.application_id=a AND d.present
          AND (NOT coalesce(n.present,false) OR n.resulting_amount IS DISTINCT FROM d.total)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RECONSTRUCTION_DETAIL_HISTORY_TOTAL_CONFLICT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS(WITH d AS(SELECT DISTINCT ON(coordinate_id) coordinate_id,present,total
        FROM epm.line_detail_event WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a
        ORDER BY coordinate_id,committed_revision DESC),
        n AS(SELECT DISTINCT ON(coordinate_id) coordinate_id,present,resulting_amount
        FROM epm.numeric_fact_event WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a
        ORDER BY coordinate_id,committed_revision DESC,line_ordinal DESC)
        SELECT 1 FROM d LEFT JOIN n USING(coordinate_id) WHERE d.present
          AND (NOT coalesce(n.present,false) OR n.resulting_amount IS DISTINCT FROM d.total)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RECONSTRUCTION_DETAIL_TOTAL_CONFLICT'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
END ';
ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."fact_reconstruction_validate"("w" "text", "a" "text", "head" bigint) OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."fact_scope_check"("w" "text", "a" "text", "workspace_only" boolean DEFAULT false) RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
BEGIN
    \x2d- Owners bypass RLS for migration/recovery; normal invoker callbacks must
    \x2d- never silently skip their rows after a transaction changes its RLS scope.
    IF pg_has_role(current_user,(SELECT relowner FROM pg_class WHERE oid=''epm.operation_receipt''::regclass),''USAGE'') THEN RETURN; END IF;
    IF current_setting(''epm.workspace_id'',true) IS DISTINCT FROM w OR
       (current_setting(''epm.application_id'',true) IS DISTINCT FROM a AND NOT
          (workspace_only AND pg_has_role(current_user,''epm_lifecycle'',''member''))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''FACT_PUBLICATION_SCOPE_CHANGED'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."finalize_planning_seed_lineage"("p_workspace" "text", "p_application" "text", "p_batch" "text", "p_revision" bigint) RETURNS bigint
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
DECLARE changed bigint;
BEGIN
  IF p_workspace IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting(''epm.workspace_id'',true)
     OR p_application IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting(''epm.application_id'',true)
     OR p_revision<1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''PLANNING_SEED_LINEAGE_FINALIZE_SCOPE_INVALID'';
  END IF;
  UPDATE epm.planning_seed_lineage l SET
    target_coordinate_id=c.coordinate_id,
    target_change_id=CASE WHEN l.value_family=''Text''
                          THEN t.change_id ELSE n.change_id END,
    target_detail_change_id=CASE WHEN l.value_family=''Detail''
                                 THEN d.change_id END,
    target_committed_revision=p_revision
  FROM epm.coordinate c
  LEFT JOIN epm.numeric_fact_event n ON n.workspace_id=c.workspace_id
   AND n.application_id=c.application_id AND n.coordinate_id=c.coordinate_id
   AND n.operation_id=p_batch
  LEFT JOIN epm.text_fact_event t ON t.workspace_id=c.workspace_id
   AND t.application_id=c.application_id AND t.coordinate_id=c.coordinate_id
   AND t.operation_id=p_batch
  LEFT JOIN epm.line_detail_event d ON d.workspace_id=c.workspace_id
   AND d.application_id=c.application_id AND d.coordinate_id=c.coordinate_id
   AND d.operation_id=p_batch
  WHERE l.workspace_id=p_workspace AND l.application_id=p_application
   AND l.batch_id=p_batch AND l.target_coordinate_id IS NULL
   AND c.workspace_id=l.workspace_id AND c.application_id=l.application_id
   AND c.series_key=l.target_series_key;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS changed=ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN changed;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."forecast_occurrence_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer, "p_global_limit" integer, "p_workspace_limit" integer, "p_application_limit" integer) RETURNS TABLE("workspace_id" "text", "application_id" "text", "occurrence_id" "text", "status" "text", "claim_generation" bigint)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE candidate record;
BEGIN
  IF p_claimant IS NULL OR length(p_claimant) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
     OR p_lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 300
     OR p_global_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000
     OR p_workspace_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p_global_limit
     OR p_application_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p_workspace_limit THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''FORECAST_WORKER_CLAIM_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023'';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(''epm.forecast.occurrence.dispatch'',0));
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.planning_forecast_occurrence global_active
       WHERE global_active.status IN (''running'',''cancel_requested'')
         AND global_active.lease_until>clock_timestamp())>=p_global_limit
  THEN RETURN; END IF;
  SELECT o.* INTO candidate FROM epm.planning_forecast_occurrence o
    JOIN epm.application a USING(workspace_id,application_id)
    JOIN epm.application_state ast USING(workspace_id,application_id)
    JOIN epm.workspace w USING(workspace_id)
    LEFT JOIN epm.worker_workspace_dispatch d ON d.workspace_id=o.workspace_id
   WHERE (o.status=''ready'' OR
          (o.status IN (''running'',''cancel_requested'') AND o.lease_until<=clock_timestamp()))
     AND a.status=''Active'' AND w.status=''Active'' AND ast.processing_mode=''Active''
     AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.planning_forecast_occurrence active
           WHERE active.workspace_id=o.workspace_id
             AND active.status IN (''running'',''cancel_requested'')
             AND active.lease_until>clock_timestamp())<p_workspace_limit
     AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.planning_forecast_occurrence active
           WHERE active.workspace_id=o.workspace_id
             AND active.application_id=o.application_id
             AND active.status IN (''running'',''cancel_requested'')
             AND active.lease_until>clock_timestamp())<p_application_limit
   ORDER BY d.last_claim_sequence NULLS FIRST,
     (o.status=''cancel_requested'') DESC,o.due_at,o.created_at,o.occurrence_id
   FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
  UPDATE epm.planning_forecast_occurrence o SET
    status=CASE WHEN o.status=''ready'' THEN ''running'' ELSE o.status END,
    claim_generation=o.claim_generation+1,claimant=p_claimant,
    lease_until=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>p_lease_seconds),
    updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
   WHERE o.workspace_id=candidate.workspace_id
     AND o.application_id=candidate.application_id
     AND o.occurrence_id=candidate.occurrence_id;
  INSERT INTO epm.worker_workspace_dispatch(workspace_id,last_claim_sequence,claim_count)
    VALUES(candidate.workspace_id,nextval(''epm.worker_dispatch_sequence''),1)
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT worker_workspace_dispatch_pkey DO UPDATE SET
      last_claim_sequence=EXCLUDED.last_claim_sequence,
      claim_count=epm.worker_workspace_dispatch.claim_count+1;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT candidate.workspace_id,candidate.application_id,
    candidate.occurrence_id,
    CASE WHEN candidate.status=''ready'' THEN ''running'' ELSE candidate.status END,
    candidate.claim_generation+1;
END ';

ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."forecast_occurrence_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer, "p_global_limit" integer, "p_workspace_limit" integer, "p_application_limit" integer) OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."forecast_schedule_worker_block_revoked"() RETURNS boolean
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE candidate record;
BEGIN
 SELECT s.*,v.delegation_id,v.delegation_version,v.execution_issuer,v.execution_subject
 INTO candidate FROM epm.planning_forecast_schedule_state s
 JOIN epm.planning_forecast_schedule_version v ON
  (v.workspace_id,v.application_id,v.schedule_id,v.version)=
  (s.workspace_id,s.application_id,s.schedule_id,s.active_version)
 WHERE s.active_version IS NOT NULL AND s.dispatch_status=''Active''
  AND v.first_due_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND (s.last_due_at IS NULL OR s.last_due_at+make_interval(secs=>v.interval_seconds)<=clock_timestamp())
  AND NOT epm.execution_delegation_is_current(s.workspace_id,s.application_id,
   v.delegation_id,v.delegation_version,v.execution_issuer,v.execution_subject,
   ''facts.planning.forecast.occurrence.request'',s.schedule_id,s.active_version)
 ORDER BY s.workspace_id,s.application_id,s.schedule_id FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 UPDATE epm.planning_forecast_schedule_state SET dispatch_status=''Blocked'',
  blocked_code=''FORECAST_EXECUTION_DELEGATION_REVOKED'',blocked_at=clock_timestamp(),
  dispatch_claimant=NULL,dispatch_lease_until=NULL,updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
 WHERE workspace_id=candidate.workspace_id AND application_id=candidate.application_id
  AND schedule_id=candidate.schedule_id;
 INSERT INTO epm.planning_forecast_schedule_event(workspace_id,application_id,schedule_id,
  event_type,schedule_version,prior_last_due_at,reason_code)
 VALUES(candidate.workspace_id,candidate.application_id,candidate.schedule_id,''Blocked'',
  candidate.active_version,candidate.last_due_at,''FORECAST_EXECUTION_DELEGATION_REVOKED'');
 RETURN true;
END ';
ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."forecast_schedule_worker_block_revoked"() OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."forecast_schedule_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer) RETURNS TABLE("workspace_id" "text", "application_id" "text", "schedule_id" "text", "dispatch_generation" bigint)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE candidate record;
BEGIN
 IF p_claimant IS NULL OR length(p_claimant) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
  OR p_lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 300 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''FORECAST_WORKER_CLAIM_INVALID''; END IF;
 SELECT s.* INTO candidate FROM epm.planning_forecast_schedule_state s
 JOIN epm.planning_forecast_schedule_version v ON
  (v.workspace_id,v.application_id,v.schedule_id,v.version)=
  (s.workspace_id,s.application_id,s.schedule_id,s.active_version)
 JOIN epm.application a ON a.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND a.application_id=s.application_id
 JOIN epm.application_state ast ON ast.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND ast.application_id=s.application_id
 JOIN epm.workspace w ON w.workspace_id=s.workspace_id
 LEFT JOIN epm.worker_workspace_dispatch d ON d.workspace_id=s.workspace_id
 WHERE s.active_version IS NOT NULL AND s.dispatch_status=''Active''
  AND (s.dispatch_lease_until IS NULL OR s.dispatch_lease_until<=clock_timestamp())
  AND v.first_due_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND (s.last_due_at IS NULL OR s.last_due_at+make_interval(secs=>v.interval_seconds)<=clock_timestamp())
  AND a.status=''Active'' AND w.status=''Active'' AND ast.processing_mode=''Active''
  AND epm.execution_delegation_is_current(s.workspace_id,s.application_id,v.delegation_id,
   v.delegation_version,v.execution_issuer,v.execution_subject,
   ''facts.planning.forecast.occurrence.request'',s.schedule_id,s.active_version)
 ORDER BY d.last_claim_sequence NULLS FIRST,COALESCE(s.last_due_at,v.first_due_at),
  s.workspace_id,s.application_id,s.schedule_id FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
 UPDATE epm.planning_forecast_schedule_state s SET dispatch_generation=s.dispatch_generation+1,
  dispatch_claimant=p_claimant,dispatch_lease_until=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>p_lease_seconds),
  updated_at=transaction_timestamp() WHERE s.workspace_id=candidate.workspace_id
  AND s.application_id=candidate.application_id AND s.schedule_id=candidate.schedule_id;
 INSERT INTO epm.worker_workspace_dispatch(workspace_id,last_claim_sequence,claim_count)
 VALUES(candidate.workspace_id,nextval(''epm.worker_dispatch_sequence''),1)
 ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT worker_workspace_dispatch_pkey DO UPDATE SET
  last_claim_sequence=EXCLUDED.last_claim_sequence,
  claim_count=epm.worker_workspace_dispatch.claim_count+1;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT candidate.workspace_id,candidate.application_id,candidate.schedule_id,
  candidate.dispatch_generation+1;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."inventory_unrealized_pointer_complete"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
DECLARE actual bigint; units bigint; evidence bigint; receipt jsonb;
 evidence_min text; evidence_max text; lineage_count bigint;
 legacy_count bigint; generation_row record; invalid_rows bigint;
 opening numeric; creation numeric; release numeric; closing numeric;
 source_min numeric;source_max numeric;revenue numeric;cost numeric;prior numeric;
 source_count bigint;source_mapping_invalid bigint;
 schedule_matches bigint;invalid_storage bigint;
 entity_dimension text;expected_entity text;
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.calculation_generation g WHERE
  g.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND g.application_id=NEW.application_id
  AND g.generation_id=NEW.generation_id
  AND g.function_name=''consolidation.inventory.unrealized_profit.request'') THEN
  SELECT g.row_count,g.result_key,g.published_revision,j.compiler_version,
    j.normalized_program,j.expected_metadata_revision,
    j.expected_data_revision,j.expected_policy_revision
   INTO generation_row FROM epm.calculation_generation g JOIN epm.job j
    ON (j.workspace_id,j.application_id,j.job_id)=(g.workspace_id,g.application_id,g.job_id)
   WHERE g.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND g.application_id=NEW.application_id
    AND g.generation_id=NEW.generation_id;
  SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT (output_unit_currency_dimension_id,
    output_unit_currency_member_id)),count(DISTINCT source_evidence_digest),
    min(source_evidence_digest),max(source_evidence_digest),
    count(DISTINCT source_lookup_lineage),min(source_amount),max(source_amount),
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE rate_strategy<>''identity-same-currency''
      OR rate_numerator<>1 OR rate_denominator<>1
      OR rate_sources IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
       ''kind'',''Identity'',''currency'',jsonb_build_object(
        ''dimensionId'',output_unit_currency_dimension_id,
        ''memberId'',output_unit_currency_member_id))))
   INTO actual,units,evidence,evidence_min,evidence_max,lineage_count,
    source_min,source_max,invalid_storage
   FROM epm.calculation_unit_result WHERE
    workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND application_id=NEW.application_id
    AND generation_id=NEW.generation_id;
  SELECT result INTO receipt FROM epm.operation_receipt WHERE
    workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND application_id=NEW.application_id
    AND operation_id=NEW.generation_id;
  SELECT count(*) INTO legacy_count FROM epm.calculation_result WHERE
   workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND application_id=NEW.application_id
   AND generation_id=NEW.generation_id;
  IF receipt IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(receipt->''rows'')=''array'' THEN
   SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.coordinate_id IS NULL OR
      c.members IS DISTINCT FROM generation_row.normalized_program->
       ''targetMembers''->(x->>''role'')),
    max(CASE WHEN x->>''role''=''Opening'' AND x->>''amount''~''^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$''
      THEN (x->>''amount'')::numeric END),
    max(CASE WHEN x->>''role''=''Creation'' AND x->>''amount''~''^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$''
      THEN (x->>''amount'')::numeric END),
    max(CASE WHEN x->>''role''=''Release'' AND x->>''amount''~''^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$''
      THEN (x->>''amount'')::numeric END),
    max(CASE WHEN x->>''role''=''Closing'' AND x->>''amount''~''^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$''
      THEN (x->>''amount'')::numeric END)
   INTO invalid_rows,opening,creation,release,closing
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(receipt->''rows'') x
   LEFT JOIN epm.coordinate c ON c.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
    AND c.application_id=NEW.application_id AND c.members=x->''members''
   LEFT JOIN epm.calculation_unit_result r ON r.workspace_id=c.workspace_id
    AND r.application_id=c.application_id AND r.coordinate_id=c.coordinate_id
    AND r.generation_id=NEW.generation_id AND r.amount=CASE
     WHEN x->>''amount''~''^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'' THEN (x->>''amount'')::numeric END;
  ELSE invalid_rows:=1; END IF;
  IF receipt IS NOT NULL AND (CASE
   WHEN jsonb_typeof(receipt->''sourceLookupLineage'')=''array''
    THEN jsonb_array_length(receipt->''sourceLookupLineage'')=1
   ELSE false END) THEN
   IF jsonb_typeof(receipt->''sourceLookupLineage''->0->''sources'')=''array'' THEN
    SELECT count(*),
     count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT (
      (s->''members''=generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->
        ''transferRevenue''->''members'' AND s->>''changeId''=
        generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->''transferRevenue''->>''changeId'')
      OR (s->''members''=generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->
        ''transferCost''->''members'' AND s->>''changeId''=
        generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->''transferCost''->>''changeId'')
      OR (s->''members''=generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->
        ''priorUnrealizedProfit''->''members'' AND s->>''changeId''=
        generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->''priorUnrealizedProfit''->>''changeId''))),
     max(CASE WHEN s->>''changeId''=generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->
       ''transferRevenue''->>''changeId'' AND s->''members''=
       generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->''transferRevenue''->''members''
       AND s->>''amount''~''^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$''
       THEN (s->>''amount'')::numeric END),
     max(CASE WHEN s->>''changeId''=generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->
       ''transferCost''->>''changeId'' AND s->''members''=
       generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->''transferCost''->''members''
       AND s->>''amount''~''^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$''
       THEN (s->>''amount'')::numeric END),
     max(CASE WHEN s->>''changeId''=generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->
       ''priorUnrealizedProfit''->>''changeId'' AND s->''members''=
       generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->''priorUnrealizedProfit''->''members''
       AND s->>''amount''~''^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$''
       THEN (s->>''amount'')::numeric END)
    INTO source_count,source_mapping_invalid,revenue,cost,prior
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(receipt->''sourceLookupLineage''->0->''sources'') s;
   ELSE source_count:=-1;source_mapping_invalid:=-1; END IF;
  ELSE source_count:=-1;source_mapping_invalid:=-1; END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO schedule_matches
   FROM epm.inventory_unrealized_schedule_state s
   JOIN epm.inventory_unrealized_schedule_version v ON
    (v.workspace_id,v.application_id,v.schedule_id,v.version)=
    (s.workspace_id,s.application_id,s.schedule_id,s.active_version)
   WHERE s.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND s.application_id=NEW.application_id
    AND s.schedule_id=generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->>''scheduleId''
    AND to_jsonb(s.active_version)=generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->''scheduleVersion''
    AND v.definition=generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''
    AND v.definition_digest=receipt->>''scheduleDigest'';
  SELECT dimension_id INTO entity_dimension FROM epm.dimension
   WHERE workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND application_id=NEW.application_id
    AND model_role=''Entity'' AND status=''Active'';
  expected_entity:=generation_row.normalized_program->''targetMembers''->''Opening''->>entity_dimension;
  IF actual<>4 OR generation_row.row_count<>4 OR legacy_count<>0
   OR generation_row.result_key IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.result_key
   OR generation_row.published_revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.published_revision
   OR generation_row.compiler_version IS DISTINCT FROM ''inventory-unrealized-profit-v2-typed-unit''
   OR units<>1 OR evidence<>1 OR evidence_min IS NULL
   OR evidence_min<>evidence_max OR lineage_count<>1 OR receipt IS NULL
   OR invalid_storage<>0 OR source_min IS NULL OR source_min<>source_max
   OR source_count<>3 OR source_mapping_invalid<>0
   OR revenue IS NULL OR cost IS NULL OR prior IS NULL
   OR source_min IS DISTINCT FROM revenue-cost OR opening IS DISTINCT FROM prior
   OR schedule_matches<>1
   OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(receipt->''rows'')=''array''
      THEN jsonb_array_length(receipt->''rows'') IS DISTINCT FROM 4 ELSE true END)
   OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(receipt->''rows'')=''array'' THEN
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>''role'') FROM jsonb_array_elements(receipt->''rows'') x
       WHERE x->>''role'' IN (''Opening'',''Creation'',''Release'',''Closing''))<>4
      ELSE true END)
   OR invalid_rows<>0 OR opening IS NULL OR creation IS NULL OR release IS NULL
   OR closing IS NULL OR opening+creation+release IS DISTINCT FROM closing
   OR receipt->>''generationId'' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.generation_id
   OR receipt->>''resultKey'' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.result_key
   OR receipt->''publishedRevision'' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.published_revision)
   OR receipt->>''sourceEvidenceDigest'' IS DISTINCT FROM evidence_min
   OR receipt->''sourceLookupLineage'' IS DISTINCT FROM
      (SELECT source_lookup_lineage FROM epm.calculation_unit_result WHERE
       workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND application_id=NEW.application_id
       AND generation_id=NEW.generation_id LIMIT 1)
   OR receipt->>''compilerVersion'' IS DISTINCT FROM generation_row.compiler_version
   OR receipt->>''scheduleId'' IS DISTINCT FROM
      generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->>''scheduleId''
   OR receipt->''scheduleVersion'' IS DISTINCT FROM
      generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->''scheduleVersion''
   OR receipt->>''scheduleDigest'' IS DISTINCT FROM
      receipt->''sourceLookupLineage''->0->>''scheduleDigest''
   OR receipt->''revisionPins'' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
      ''metadata'',generation_row.expected_metadata_revision,
      ''data'',generation_row.expected_data_revision,
      ''policy'',generation_row.expected_policy_revision)
   OR entity_dimension IS NULL OR expected_entity IS NULL
   OR receipt->''functionalCurrencyContext'' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
      ''entity'',jsonb_build_object(''dimensionId'',entity_dimension,
       ''memberId'',expected_entity))
   OR receipt->''outputUnit'' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
      ''dimensionId'',generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->>''currencyDimensionId'',
      ''memberId'',generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->>''currencyMemberId'')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.member m WHERE
      m.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND m.application_id=NEW.application_id
      AND m.dimension_id=entity_dimension AND m.member_id=expected_entity
      AND m.status=''Active'' AND m.entity_default_currency_member_id=
       generation_row.normalized_program->''definition''->>''currencyMemberId'')
   OR receipt->''outputUnit'' IS DISTINCT FROM
      (SELECT jsonb_build_object(''dimensionId'',output_unit_currency_dimension_id,
       ''memberId'',output_unit_currency_member_id) FROM epm.calculation_unit_result WHERE
       workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND application_id=NEW.application_id
       AND generation_id=NEW.generation_id LIMIT 1) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION ''INVENTORY_UNREALIZED_PUBLICATION_INCOMPLETE'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."inventory_unrealized_unit_line_open"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_unrealized_unit_inserted i
  JOIN epm.calculation_generation g USING(workspace_id,application_id,generation_id)
  JOIN epm.job j ON (j.workspace_id,j.application_id,j.job_id)=
   (g.workspace_id,g.application_id,g.job_id)
  WHERE g.function_name=''consolidation.inventory.unrealized_profit.request''
   AND (j.compiler_version<>''inventory-unrealized-profit-v2-typed-unit''
        OR j.status<>''running'')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''INVENTORY_UNREALIZED_GENERATION_SEALED'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."layout_activation_record_events"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
DECLARE x epm.layout_replacement_activation%ROWTYPE;
DECLARE generation text;
BEGIN
    IF NEW.active_projection_generation=OLD.active_projection_generation THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    SELECT * INTO x FROM epm.layout_replacement_activation
     WHERE workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND application_id=NEW.application_id
       AND target_projection_generation=NEW.active_projection_generation
       AND status=''Activating'';
    IF NOT FOUND OR NOT epm.layout_replacement_activation_allowed(
        NEW.workspace_id,NEW.application_id,
        NEW.active_projection_generation,''activate'') THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;
    SELECT generation_id INTO generation
      FROM epm.layout_replacement_validation_certificate
     WHERE workspace_id=x.workspace_id AND application_id=x.application_id
       AND request_id=x.request_id;

    INSERT INTO epm.operation_receipt(workspace_id,application_id,operation_id,
        command_digest,actor_id,committed_revision,result)
    VALUES(x.workspace_id,x.application_id,x.activation_id,x.validation_digest,
        x.subject_id,NEW.commit_revision,jsonb_build_object(
        ''activationId'',x.activation_id,''requestId'',x.request_id,
        ''committedRevision'',NEW.commit_revision,''schemaEpoch'',x.target_schema_epoch,
        ''projectionGeneration'',x.target_projection_generation,
        ''historyPreserved'',true));

    INSERT INTO epm.numeric_fact_event(workspace_id,application_id,coordinate_id,
        operation_id,line_ordinal,kind,delta,present,resulting_amount,change_id,
        committed_revision)
    SELECT x.workspace_id,x.application_id,m.coordinate_id,x.activation_id,
        row_number() OVER(ORDER BY m.coordinate_id),
        CASE WHEN n.present THEN ''set'' ELSE ''clear'' END,
        coalesce(n.amount,0)-coalesce(prior.resulting_amount,0),
        n.present,n.amount,''layout:''||x.activation_id,NEW.commit_revision
      FROM epm.layout_replacement_activation_coordinate m
      JOIN epm.layout_replacement_private_numeric n
        ON n.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND n.application_id=m.application_id
       AND n.target_digest=m.target_digest AND n.generation_id=generation
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT e.resulting_amount
          FROM epm.numeric_fact_event e
         WHERE e.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND e.application_id=m.application_id
           AND e.coordinate_id=m.coordinate_id
         ORDER BY e.committed_revision DESC,e.line_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1)prior ON true
     WHERE m.workspace_id=x.workspace_id AND m.application_id=x.application_id
       AND m.activation_id=x.activation_id;

    INSERT INTO epm.text_fact_event(workspace_id,application_id,coordinate_id,
        operation_id,line_ordinal,kind,prior_present,prior_value,present,
        resulting_value,change_id,committed_revision)
    SELECT x.workspace_id,x.application_id,m.coordinate_id,x.activation_id,
        row_number() OVER(ORDER BY m.coordinate_id),
        CASE WHEN t.present THEN ''set'' ELSE ''clear'' END,
        coalesce(prior.present,false),prior.resulting_value,t.present,t.text_value,
        ''layout:''||x.activation_id,NEW.commit_revision
      FROM epm.layout_replacement_activation_coordinate m
      JOIN epm.layout_replacement_private_text t
        ON t.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND t.application_id=m.application_id
       AND t.target_digest=m.target_digest AND t.generation_id=generation
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT e.present,e.resulting_value
          FROM epm.text_fact_event e
         WHERE e.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND e.application_id=m.application_id
           AND e.coordinate_id=m.coordinate_id
         ORDER BY e.committed_revision DESC,e.line_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1)prior ON true
     WHERE m.workspace_id=x.workspace_id AND m.application_id=x.application_id
       AND m.activation_id=x.activation_id;

    INSERT INTO epm.line_detail_event(workspace_id,application_id,coordinate_id,
        operation_id,prior_items,prior_total,items,total,change_id,
        committed_revision,present)
    SELECT x.workspace_id,x.application_id,m.coordinate_id,x.activation_id,
        prior.items,prior.total,
        CASE WHEN d.present THEN d.items ELSE ''[]''::jsonb END,
        CASE WHEN d.present THEN d.total ELSE 0 END,
        ''layout:''||x.activation_id,NEW.commit_revision,d.present
      FROM epm.layout_replacement_activation_coordinate m
      JOIN epm.layout_replacement_private_detail d
        ON d.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND d.application_id=m.application_id
       AND d.target_digest=m.target_digest AND d.generation_id=generation
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT e.present,e.items,e.total
          FROM epm.line_detail_event e
         WHERE e.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND e.application_id=m.application_id
           AND e.coordinate_id=m.coordinate_id
         ORDER BY e.committed_revision DESC LIMIT 1)prior ON true
     WHERE m.workspace_id=x.workspace_id AND m.application_id=x.application_id
       AND m.activation_id=x.activation_id
       AND (d.present OR coalesce(prior.present,false));
    RETURN NULL;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."layout_replacement_materialization_claim"("p_workspace" "text", "p_application" "text", "p_request" "text", "p_claimant" "text", "p_seconds" integer) RETURNS TABLE("request_id" "text", "generation_id" "text", "claim_generation" bigint, "next_chunk" integer)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E' BEGIN
 IF length(p_claimant) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 OR p_seconds NOT BETWEEN 30 AND 300 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''LAYOUT_MATERIALIZATION_CLAIM_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
 INSERT INTO epm.layout_replacement_materialization(workspace_id,application_id,request_id,generation_id)
 SELECT r.workspace_id,r.application_id,r.request_id,r.target_generation_id
 FROM epm.layout_replacement_request r WHERE r.workspace_id=p_workspace
 AND r.application_id=p_application AND r.request_id=p_request AND r.status=''Staged''
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 RETURN QUERY UPDATE epm.layout_replacement_materialization m SET status=''Running'',
  claim_generation=m.claim_generation+1,claimant=p_claimant,
  lease_until=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>p_seconds),updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
 FROM epm.layout_replacement_request r WHERE m.workspace_id=p_workspace
  AND m.application_id=p_application AND m.request_id=p_request AND m.status=''Ready''
  AND r.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND r.application_id=m.application_id
  AND r.request_id=m.request_id AND r.status=''Staged''
 RETURNING m.request_id,m.generation_id,m.claim_generation,m.next_chunk;

 UPDATE epm.layout_replacement_materialization SET status=''Ready'',

    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE changed integer;
BEGIN
 UPDATE epm.layout_replacement_materialization SET
  status=CASE WHEN p_error IS NULL THEN ''Complete'' ELSE ''Failed'' END,
  content_digest=CASE WHEN p_error IS NULL THEN p_digest ELSE NULL END,error_code=p_error,
  claimant=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
 WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND application_id=p_application AND request_id=p_request
  AND status=''Running'' AND claimant=p_claimant AND claim_generation=p_generation
  AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND target_count=p_expected
  AND ((p_error IS NULL AND p_digest ~ ''^[0-9a-f]{64}$'') OR
       (p_error ~ ''^[A-Z0-9_]{1,200}$''));
 GET DIAGNOSTICS changed=ROW_COUNT;RETURN changed=1;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."layout_replacement_validation_publish"("p_workspace" "text", "p_application" "text", "p_request" "text", "p_content" "text", "p_count" integer, "p_certificate" "jsonb") RETURNS "text"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE r epm.layout_replacement_request%ROWTYPE;m epm.layout_replacement_materialization%ROWTYPE;
 eligible boolean;digest text;target_status text;
BEGIN
 IF p_workspace IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting(''epm.workspace_id'',true)
 OR p_application IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting(''epm.application_id'',true)
 OR jsonb_typeof(p_certificate)<>''object'' OR octet_length(p_certificate::text)>1048576 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''LAYOUT_VALIDATION_PUBLISH_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023'';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM epm.layout_replacement_request WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace
  AND application_id=p_application AND request_id=p_request FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO m FROM epm.layout_replacement_materialization WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace
  AND application_id=p_application AND request_id=p_request;
 eligible:=(p_certificate->>''activationEligible'')::boolean;
 digest:=p_certificate->>''validationDigest'';target_status:=CASE WHEN eligible THEN ''Validated'' ELSE ''ValidationFailed'' END;
 IF r.status<> ''Staged'' OR m.status<>''Complete'' OR m.content_digest<>p_content
 OR m.target_count<>p_count OR p_content !~ ''^[0-9a-f]{64}$'' OR digest !~ ''^[0-9a-f]{64}$''
 OR p_certificate->>''requestId''<>p_request OR p_certificate->>''planDigest''<>r.plan_digest
 OR p_certificate->>''privateGenerationId''<>r.target_generation_id
 OR (p_certificate->''pins''->>''metadataRevision'')::bigint<>r.metadata_revision
 OR (p_certificate->''pins''->>''dataRevision'')::bigint<>r.data_revision
 OR (p_certificate->''pins''->>''policyRevision'')::bigint<>r.policy_revision
 OR (p_certificate->''pins''->>''schemaEpoch'')::bigint<>r.schema_epoch
 OR (p_certificate->''pins''->>''sourceCommitRevision'')::bigint<>r.source_commit_revision
 OR (p_certificate->>''stagedTargetCount'')::integer<>p_count
 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epm.application_state s WHERE s.workspace_id=p_workspace
   AND s.application_id=p_application AND NOT s.commit_open
   AND s.metadata_revision=r.metadata_revision AND s.data_revision=r.data_revision
   AND s.policy_revision=r.policy_revision AND s.schema_epoch=r.schema_epoch
   AND s.commit_revision=r.source_commit_revision) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''LAYOUT_VALIDATION_PUBLISH_STALE'';END IF;
 INSERT INTO epm.layout_replacement_validation_certificate
  (workspace_id,application_id,request_id,generation_id,plan_digest,
   metadata_revision,data_revision,policy_revision,schema_epoch,source_commit_revision,
   content_digest,target_count,validation_digest,activation_eligible,certificate)
 VALUES(p_workspace,p_application,p_request,r.target_generation_id,r.plan_digest,
   r.metadata_revision,r.data_revision,r.policy_revision,r.schema_epoch,r.source_commit_revision,
   p_content,p_count,digest,eligible,p_certificate);
 UPDATE epm.layout_replacement_request SET status=target_status,updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
  WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND application_id=p_application AND request_id=p_request;
 RETURN target_status;
END ';

ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."layout_replacement_validation_publish"("p_workspace" "text", "p_application" "text", "p_request" "text", "p_content" "text", "p_count" integer, "p_certificate" "jsonb") OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."layout_replacement_worker_claim"("p_workspace" "text", "p_application" "text", "p_request" "text", "p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer) RETURNS TABLE("request_id" "text", "generation_id" "text", "plan" "jsonb", "claim_generation" bigint)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
BEGIN
 IF p_claimant IS NULL OR length(p_claimant) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
 OR p_lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 30 AND 300 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''LAYOUT_REPLACEMENT_CLAIM_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023'';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY UPDATE epm.layout_replacement_request r SET status=''Staging'',
  claim_generation=r.claim_generation+1,claimant=p_claimant,
  lease_until=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>p_lease_seconds),
  updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
 WHERE r.workspace_id=p_workspace AND r.application_id=p_application
  AND r.request_id=p_request AND r.status=''Accepted''
 RETURNING r.request_id,r.target_generation_id,r.plan,r.claim_generation;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."layout_replacement_worker_settle"("p_workspace" "text", "p_application" "text", "p_request" "text", "p_claimant" "text", "p_generation" bigint, "p_outcome" "text", "p_error" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS boolean
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE changed integer;
BEGIN
 IF p_outcome NOT IN (''Staged'',''Failed'') OR (p_outcome=''Failed'')<>(p_error IS NOT NULL)
 OR (p_error IS NOT NULL AND (length(p_error) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 OR p_error !~ ''^[A-Z0-9_]+$'')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''LAYOUT_REPLACEMENT_SETTLEMENT_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
 UPDATE epm.layout_replacement_request r SET status=p_outcome,error_code=p_error,
  claimant=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
 WHERE r.workspace_id=p_workspace AND r.application_id=p_application
  AND r.request_id=p_request AND r.status=''Staging'' AND r.claimant=p_claimant
  AND r.claim_generation=p_generation AND r.lease_until>clock_timestamp()
  AND (p_outcome=''Failed'' OR r.expected_coordinate_count=(SELECT count(*)
    FROM epm.layout_replacement_staged_coordinate c WHERE c.workspace_id=r.workspace_id
    AND c.application_id=r.application_id AND c.generation_id=r.target_generation_id));
 GET DIAGNOSTICS changed=ROW_COUNT; RETURN changed=1;
END ';

    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE changed integer;
BEGIN
 IF p_source<1 OR p_digest !~ ''^[0-9a-f]{64}$'' OR jsonb_typeof(p_members)<>''object''
 OR octet_length(p_members::text)>1048576 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''LAYOUT_REPLACEMENT_STAGE_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
 INSERT INTO epm.layout_replacement_staged_coordinate
  (workspace_id,application_id,generation_id,source_coordinate_id,target_members,target_digest)
 SELECT r.workspace_id,r.application_id,r.target_generation_id,p_source,p_members,p_digest
 FROM epm.layout_replacement_request r WHERE r.workspace_id=p_workspace
  AND r.application_id=p_application AND r.request_id=p_request
  AND r.status=''Staging'' AND r.claimant=p_claimant
  AND r.claim_generation=p_generation AND r.lease_until>clock_timestamp()
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.plan->''coordinateMappings'') m
    WHERE (m->>''sourceCoordinateId'')::bigint=p_source
      AND m->''targetMembers''=p_members)
 ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,application_id,generation_id,source_coordinate_id)
 DO UPDATE SET target_members=EXCLUDED.target_members
 WHERE epm.layout_replacement_staged_coordinate.target_digest=EXCLUDED.target_digest;
 GET DIAGNOSTICS changed=ROW_COUNT; RETURN changed=1;
END ';

    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM period_inserted i
  JOIN epm.calculation_generation g USING(workspace_id,application_id,generation_id)
  JOIN epm.job j ON j.workspace_id=g.workspace_id
   AND j.application_id=g.application_id AND j.job_id=g.job_id
  WHERE g.function_name IN (''consolidation.nci.period.publish'',
                            ''consolidation.nci.period.withdraw'')
   AND (j.compiler_version IN (''period-nci-attribution-v7-typed-unit'',
        ''period-nci-attribution-v8-ic-adjusted-typed-unit'')
        OR g.function_name<>''consolidation.nci.period.publish''
        OR j.status<>''running'')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''PERIOD_ATTRIBUTION_GENERATION_SEALED'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END ';
