CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."period_attribution_pointer_complete"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
DECLARE kind text; compiler text; expected_rows integer; actual_rows bigint;
 generation_key text; generation_revision bigint; basis_min numeric;
 basis_max numeric; attributed numeric; evidence_min text; evidence_max text;
 unit_count bigint; lineage_count bigint; invalid_currency_rows bigint;
 legacy_rows bigint; expected_contract text;
 receipt jsonb; lineage_min jsonb; expected_source_digest text;
BEGIN
 SELECT g.function_name,g.row_count,g.result_key,g.published_revision,
        j.compiler_version,j.normalized_program->>''expectedSourceDigest''
 INTO kind,expected_rows,generation_key,generation_revision,compiler,
      expected_source_digest
 FROM epm.calculation_generation g JOIN epm.job j
  ON j.workspace_id=g.workspace_id AND j.application_id=g.application_id
  AND j.job_id=g.job_id
 WHERE g.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND g.application_id=NEW.application_id
  AND g.generation_id=NEW.generation_id;
 IF kind IN (''consolidation.nci.period.publish'',
             ''consolidation.nci.period.withdraw'') THEN
  SELECT o.result INTO receipt FROM epm.operation_receipt o
   WHERE o.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
    AND o.application_id=NEW.application_id
    AND o.operation_id=NEW.generation_id
    AND o.committed_revision=NEW.published_revision
    AND o.result->>''function''=kind;
  IF compiler IN (''period-nci-attribution-v7-typed-unit'',
                  ''period-nci-attribution-v8-ic-adjusted-typed-unit'') THEN
   expected_contract := CASE compiler
    WHEN ''period-nci-attribution-v7-typed-unit''
     THEN ''owner_declared_typed_full_contribution_v1''
    ELSE ''owner_declared_ic_adjusted_typed_full_contribution_v1'' END;
   SELECT count(*) INTO legacy_rows FROM epm.calculation_result
    WHERE workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
     AND application_id=NEW.application_id
     AND generation_id=NEW.generation_id;
   SELECT count(*),min(r.source_amount),max(r.source_amount),sum(r.amount),
    min(r.source_evidence_digest),max(r.source_evidence_digest),
    count(DISTINCT (r.output_unit_currency_dimension_id,
                    r.output_unit_currency_member_id)),
    count(DISTINCT r.source_lookup_lineage),
    min(r.source_lookup_lineage::text)::jsonb,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.dimension d
      WHERE d.workspace_id=r.workspace_id AND d.application_id=r.application_id
       AND d.model_role=''Currency'' AND d.status=''Active''
       AND c.members ? d.dimension_id))
   INTO actual_rows,basis_min,basis_max,attributed,evidence_min,evidence_max,
        unit_count,lineage_count,lineage_min,invalid_currency_rows
   FROM epm.calculation_unit_result r JOIN epm.coordinate c
    USING(workspace_id,application_id,coordinate_id)
   WHERE r.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
    AND r.application_id=NEW.application_id
    AND r.generation_id=NEW.generation_id;
   IF expected_source_digest IS NULL OR legacy_rows<>0
      OR generation_key<>NEW.result_key
      OR generation_revision<>NEW.published_revision OR expected_rows<>2
      OR actual_rows<>2 OR basis_min IS NULL OR basis_min<>basis_max
      OR attributed<>basis_min OR evidence_min IS NULL
      OR evidence_min<>evidence_max OR unit_count<>1
      OR invalid_currency_rows<>0 OR lineage_count<>1
      OR receipt IS NULL
      OR receipt->>''generationId'' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.generation_id
      OR receipt->>''resultKey'' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.result_key
      OR (receipt->>''publishedRevision'')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.published_revision
      OR receipt->>''sourceContract'' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_contract
      OR receipt->>''sourceDigest'' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_source_digest
      OR receipt->>''sourceEvidenceDigest'' IS DISTINCT FROM evidence_min
      OR receipt->''sourceLookupLineage'' IS DISTINCT FROM lineage_min
      OR (receipt->''sourceEvidence''->>''basisAmount'')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM basis_min
      OR receipt->''outputUnit'' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
         ''dimensionId'',(SELECT output_unit_currency_dimension_id
           FROM epm.calculation_unit_result WHERE workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
           AND application_id=NEW.application_id
           AND generation_id=NEW.generation_id LIMIT 1),
         ''memberId'',(SELECT output_unit_currency_member_id
           FROM epm.calculation_unit_result WHERE workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
           AND application_id=NEW.application_id
           AND generation_id=NEW.generation_id LIMIT 1))
      OR lineage_min->0->>''sourceDigest'' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_source_digest
   THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''PERIOD_ATTRIBUTION_PUBLICATION_INCOMPLETE''
      USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
   END IF;
  ELSE
   SELECT count(*),min(source_amount),max(source_amount),sum(amount)
    INTO actual_rows,basis_min,basis_max,attributed
   FROM epm.calculation_result WHERE workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
    AND application_id=NEW.application_id
    AND generation_id=NEW.generation_id;
   IF generation_key<>NEW.result_key
      OR generation_revision<>NEW.published_revision
      OR expected_rows<>actual_rows OR receipt IS NULL
      OR (kind=''consolidation.nci.period.publish'' AND
          (actual_rows<>2 OR basis_min<>basis_max OR attributed<>basis_min))
      OR (kind=''consolidation.nci.period.withdraw'' AND actual_rows<>0) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''PERIOD_ATTRIBUTION_PUBLICATION_INCOMPLETE''
      USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."projection_generation_pointer_guard"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E' DECLARE x epm.layout_replacement_activation%ROWTYPE;BEGIN
 IF TG_OP=''INSERT'' THEN IF NEW.active_projection_generation<>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''PROJECTION_GENERATION_ACTIVATION_REQUIRED'';END IF;
 ELSIF NEW.active_projection_generation IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.active_projection_generation THEN
  IF epm.layout_replacement_activation_allowed(NEW.workspace_id,NEW.application_id,NEW.active_projection_generation,''activate'') THEN
   SELECT * INTO x FROM epm.layout_replacement_activation WHERE workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND application_id=NEW.application_id
    AND target_projection_generation=NEW.active_projection_generation AND status=''Activating'';
   IF NEW.schema_epoch<>x.target_schema_epoch OR OLD.schema_epoch<>x.source_schema_epoch
    OR NEW.metadata_revision<>OLD.metadata_revision+1 OR NEW.data_revision<>OLD.data_revision+1
    OR NEW.policy_revision<>OLD.policy_revision OR NEW.commit_revision<>OLD.commit_revision+1
    OR OLD.metadata_revision<>x.source_metadata_revision OR OLD.data_revision<>x.source_data_revision
    OR OLD.policy_revision<>x.source_policy_revision OR OLD.commit_revision<>x.source_commit_revision
    OR OLD.active_projection_generation<>x.source_projection_generation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''LAYOUT_ACTIVATION_POINTER_INVALID'';END IF;
  ELSE
   IF NOT epm.projection_recovery_staged_allowed(NEW.workspace_id,NEW.application_id,NEW.active_projection_generation,''activate'')
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.projection_recovery_manifest m WHERE m.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
     AND m.application_id=NEW.application_id AND m.target_generation=NEW.active_projection_generation
     AND m.original_generation=OLD.active_projection_generation AND m.source_commit_revision=OLD.commit_revision
     AND m.schema_epoch=OLD.schema_epoch AND m.metadata_revision=OLD.metadata_revision
     AND m.data_revision=OLD.data_revision AND m.policy_revision=OLD.policy_revision
     AND m.certificates=''{"coordinates":true,"numeric":true,"text":true,"detail":true,"generic":true}''::jsonb
     AND NEW.commit_revision=OLD.commit_revision+1 AND NEW.schema_epoch=OLD.schema_epoch
     AND NEW.metadata_revision=OLD.metadata_revision AND NEW.data_revision=OLD.data_revision
     AND NEW.policy_revision=OLD.policy_revision) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''PROJECTION_GENERATION_ACTIVATION_REQUIRED'';END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;RETURN NEW;END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."python_build_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer, "p_global_limit" integer, "p_workspace_limit" integer, "p_application_limit" integer) RETURNS TABLE("workspace_id" "text", "application_id" "text", "build_id" "text", "issuer" "text", "subject_id" "text", "request_digest" "text", "program_id" "text", "program_version" integer, "parameter_values" "jsonb", "environment_id" "text", "environment_version" integer, "status" "text", "claim_generation" bigint, "attempts" integer)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE candidate record;
BEGIN
  IF p_claimant IS NULL OR length(p_claimant) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
     OR p_lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 65 AND 300
     OR p_global_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000
     OR p_workspace_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p_global_limit
     OR p_application_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p_workspace_limit THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''PYTHON_BUILD_WORKER_CLAIM_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023'';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(''epm.python.build.dispatch'',0));
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.python_program_build b
      WHERE b.status IN (''running'',''cancel_requested''))>=p_global_limit THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  SELECT b.*,v.environment_id,v.environment_version INTO candidate
    FROM epm.python_program_build b
    JOIN epm.python_program_publication p ON
      p.workspace_id=b.workspace_id AND p.application_id=b.application_id
      AND p.program_id=b.program_id AND p.version=b.program_version
      AND p.status=''Published''
    JOIN epm.python_program_version v ON
      v.workspace_id=b.workspace_id AND v.application_id=b.application_id
      AND v.program_id=b.program_id AND v.version=b.program_version
    JOIN epm.python_environment_current e ON
      e.workspace_id=v.workspace_id AND e.application_id=v.application_id
      AND e.environment_id=v.environment_id AND e.version=v.environment_version
      AND e.status=''Active''
    JOIN epm.application a ON a.workspace_id=b.workspace_id
      AND a.application_id=b.application_id
    JOIN epm.application_state s ON s.workspace_id=b.workspace_id
      AND s.application_id=b.application_id
    JOIN epm.workspace w ON w.workspace_id=b.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN epm.worker_workspace_dispatch d ON d.workspace_id=b.workspace_id
    WHERE b.status IN (''accepted'',''ready'') AND b.attempts<3
      AND a.status=''Active'' AND w.status=''Active'' AND s.processing_mode=''Active''
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.python_program_build active
           WHERE active.workspace_id=b.workspace_id
             AND active.status IN (''running'',''cancel_requested''))<p_workspace_limit
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.python_program_build active
           WHERE active.workspace_id=b.workspace_id
             AND active.application_id=b.application_id
             AND active.status IN (''running'',''cancel_requested''))<p_application_limit
    ORDER BY d.last_claim_sequence NULLS FIRST,b.created_at,b.build_id
    FOR UPDATE OF b SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
  UPDATE epm.python_program_build b SET status=''running'',
    claim_generation=b.claim_generation+1,claimant=p_claimant,
    lease_until=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>p_lease_seconds),
    attempts=b.attempts+1,updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
  WHERE b.workspace_id=candidate.workspace_id
    AND b.application_id=candidate.application_id
    AND b.build_id=candidate.build_id;
  candidate.status:=''running'';
  candidate.claim_generation:=candidate.claim_generation+1;
  candidate.attempts:=candidate.attempts+1;
  INSERT INTO epm.worker_workspace_dispatch(workspace_id,last_claim_sequence,claim_count)
    VALUES(candidate.workspace_id,nextval(''epm.worker_dispatch_sequence''),1)
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT worker_workspace_dispatch_pkey DO UPDATE SET
      last_claim_sequence=EXCLUDED.last_claim_sequence,
      claim_count=epm.worker_workspace_dispatch.claim_count+1;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT candidate.workspace_id,candidate.application_id,
    candidate.build_id,candidate.issuer,candidate.subject_id,
    candidate.request_digest,candidate.program_id,candidate.program_version,
    candidate.parameter_values,candidate.environment_id,
    candidate.environment_version,candidate.status,
    candidate.claim_generation,candidate.attempts;
END ';

ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."python_build_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer, "p_global_limit" integer, "p_workspace_limit" integer, "p_application_limit" integer) OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."python_build_worker_recover"() RETURNS integer
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE changed integer:=0; step integer:=0;
BEGIN
  UPDATE epm.python_program_build b SET status=''failed'',
    error_code=''PYTHON_BUILD_PROGRAM_UNAVAILABLE'',
    updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
  WHERE b.status IN (''accepted'',''ready'') AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM epm.python_program_publication p
    JOIN epm.python_program_version v USING
      (workspace_id,application_id,program_id,version)
    JOIN epm.python_environment_current e ON
      e.workspace_id=v.workspace_id AND e.application_id=v.application_id
      AND e.environment_id=v.environment_id AND e.version=v.environment_version
      AND e.status=''Active''
    JOIN epm.application a ON a.workspace_id=b.workspace_id
      AND a.application_id=b.application_id
    JOIN epm.application_state s ON s.workspace_id=b.workspace_id
      AND s.application_id=b.application_id
    JOIN epm.workspace w ON w.workspace_id=b.workspace_id
    WHERE p.workspace_id=b.workspace_id AND p.application_id=b.application_id
      AND p.program_id=b.program_id AND p.version=b.program_version
      AND p.status=''Published'' AND a.status=''Active'' AND w.status=''Active''
      AND s.processing_mode=''Active'');
  GET DIAGNOSTICS step=ROW_COUNT; changed:=changed+step;

  UPDATE epm.python_program_build b SET
    status=CASE WHEN b.status=''cancel_requested'' THEN ''cancelled''
                WHEN b.attempts<3 THEN ''ready'' ELSE ''failed'' END,
    error_code=CASE WHEN b.status=''cancel_requested'' THEN NULL
                    WHEN b.attempts>=3 THEN ''PYTHON_BUILD_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED''
                    ELSE NULL END,
    claim_generation=b.claim_generation+1,claimant=NULL,lease_until=NULL,
    updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
  WHERE b.status IN (''running'',''cancel_requested'')
    AND b.lease_until<=clock_timestamp();
  GET DIAGNOSTICS step=ROW_COUNT; changed:=changed+step;
  RETURN changed;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."python_schedule_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease" integer) RETURNS TABLE("workspace_id" "text", "application_id" "text", "schedule_id" "text", "dispatch_generation" bigint)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E' DECLARE c record; BEGIN
 IF p_claimant IS NULL OR length(p_claimant) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 OR p_lease NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 300
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''PYTHON_SCHEDULE_CLAIM_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023''; END IF;
 SELECT s.* INTO c FROM epm.python_program_schedule_state s
 JOIN epm.python_program_schedule_version v ON (v.workspace_id,v.application_id,v.schedule_id,v.version)=(s.workspace_id,s.application_id,s.schedule_id,s.active_version)
 LEFT JOIN epm.worker_workspace_dispatch d ON d.workspace_id=s.workspace_id
 WHERE s.active_version IS NOT NULL AND (s.dispatch_lease_until IS NULL OR s.dispatch_lease_until<=clock_timestamp())
 AND v.first_due_at<=clock_timestamp() AND (s.last_due_at IS NULL OR s.last_due_at+make_interval(secs=>v.interval_seconds)<=clock_timestamp())
 AND epm.execution_delegation_is_current(s.workspace_id,s.application_id,
  v.delegation_id,v.delegation_version,v.execution_issuer,v.execution_subject,
  ''python.program.build'',s.schedule_id,s.active_version)
 AND epm.execution_delegation_is_current(s.workspace_id,s.application_id,
  v.delegation_id,v.delegation_version,v.execution_issuer,v.execution_subject,
  ''python.program.run'',s.schedule_id,s.active_version)
 ORDER BY d.last_claim_sequence NULLS FIRST,COALESCE(s.last_due_at,v.first_due_at),s.schedule_id
 FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
 UPDATE epm.python_program_schedule_state target SET dispatch_generation=target.dispatch_generation+1,
  dispatch_claimant=p_claimant,dispatch_lease_until=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>p_lease)
 WHERE target.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND target.application_id=c.application_id AND target.schedule_id=c.schedule_id;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT c.workspace_id,c.application_id,c.schedule_id,c.dispatch_generation+1;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."python_workflow_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer, "p_global_limit" integer, "p_workspace_limit" integer, "p_application_limit" integer) RETURNS TABLE("workspace_id" "text", "application_id" "text", "workflow_id" "text", "build_id" "text", "issuer" "text", "subject_id" "text", "status" "text", "claim_generation" bigint)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE candidate record;
BEGIN
  IF p_claimant IS NULL OR length(p_claimant) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
     OR p_lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 30 AND 300
     OR p_global_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000
     OR p_workspace_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p_global_limit
     OR p_application_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p_workspace_limit THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''PYTHON_WORKFLOW_WORKER_CLAIM_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023'';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(''epm.python.workflow.dispatch'',0));
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.python_program_workflow
      WHERE claimant IS NOT NULL AND lease_until>clock_timestamp())>=p_global_limit THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  SELECT w.* INTO candidate FROM epm.python_program_workflow w
    JOIN epm.application a USING(workspace_id,application_id)
    JOIN epm.application_state s USING(workspace_id,application_id)
    JOIN epm.workspace ws USING(workspace_id)
    LEFT JOIN epm.worker_workspace_dispatch d USING(workspace_id)
    WHERE w.status IN (''accepted'',''running'',''cancel_requested'')
      AND w.claimant IS NULL AND a.status=''Active'' AND ws.status=''Active''
      AND s.processing_mode=''Active''
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.python_program_workflow active
           WHERE active.workspace_id=w.workspace_id AND active.claimant IS NOT NULL
             AND active.lease_until>clock_timestamp())<p_workspace_limit
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.python_program_workflow active
           WHERE active.workspace_id=w.workspace_id
             AND active.application_id=w.application_id AND active.claimant IS NOT NULL
             AND active.lease_until>clock_timestamp())<p_application_limit
    ORDER BY d.last_claim_sequence NULLS FIRST,w.updated_at,w.workflow_id
    FOR UPDATE OF w SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
  UPDATE epm.python_program_workflow w SET claim_generation=w.claim_generation+1,
    claimant=p_claimant,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>p_lease_seconds),
    updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
    WHERE w.workspace_id=candidate.workspace_id
      AND w.application_id=candidate.application_id
      AND w.workflow_id=candidate.workflow_id;
  candidate.claim_generation:=candidate.claim_generation+1;
  INSERT INTO epm.worker_workspace_dispatch(workspace_id,last_claim_sequence,claim_count)
    VALUES(candidate.workspace_id,nextval(''epm.worker_dispatch_sequence''),1)
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT worker_workspace_dispatch_pkey DO UPDATE SET
      last_claim_sequence=EXCLUDED.last_claim_sequence,
      claim_count=epm.worker_workspace_dispatch.claim_count+1;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT candidate.workspace_id,candidate.application_id,
    candidate.workflow_id,candidate.build_id,candidate.issuer,candidate.subject_id,
    candidate.status,candidate.claim_generation;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."record_job_transition"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE next_sequence bigint;
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP=''UPDATE'' AND NEW.status=OLD.status
       AND NEW.claim_generation=OLD.claim_generation THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO epm.job_event_cursor
        (workspace_id,application_id,last_sequence)
        VALUES (NEW.workspace_id,NEW.application_id,1)
        ON CONFLICT (workspace_id,application_id) DO UPDATE
        SET last_sequence=epm.job_event_cursor.last_sequence+1
        RETURNING last_sequence INTO next_sequence;
    INSERT INTO epm.job_event
        (workspace_id,application_id,sequence,job_id,issuer,subject_id,
         status,claim_generation,receipt_revision,error_code)
        VALUES (NEW.workspace_id,NEW.application_id,next_sequence,
                NEW.job_id,NEW.issuer,NEW.subject_id,NEW.status,
                NEW.claim_generation,NEW.receipt_revision,NEW.error_code);
    RETURN NEW;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."reject_calendar_overlap"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    AS E'
BEGIN
    \x2d- Direct writers and fixed-core writers serialize on the application.
    PERFORM 1 FROM epm.application_state
        WHERE workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
          AND application_id=NEW.application_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM epm.calendar_period_current existing
        WHERE existing.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
          AND existing.application_id=NEW.application_id
          AND (existing.year_member_id,existing.period_member_id)
              IS DISTINCT FROM
              (NEW.year_member_id,NEW.period_member_id)
          AND daterange(existing.starts_on,existing.ends_before,''[)'') &&
              daterange(NEW.starts_on,NEW.ends_before,''[)'')
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''CALENDAR_PERIOD_OVERLAP'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END ';
ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."reject_calendar_overlap"() OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."reject_locked_fact_write"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM affected_rows point
        JOIN epm.coordinate c ON c.workspace_id=point.workspace_id
        AND c.application_id=point.application_id
        AND c.coordinate_id=point.coordinate_id
        JOIN epm.planning_slice_lock l
        ON l.workspace_id=point.workspace_id
        AND l.application_id=point.application_id
        AND l.status=''Locked''
        AND (l.scope_all OR c.members @> l.scope_members)
        AND NOT (TG_TABLE_NAME IN (''numeric_cell_projection'',''text_cell_projection'',''line_detail_projection'')
            AND epm.fact_reconstruction_allowed(point.workspace_id,point.application_id))
        LIMIT 1) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''PLANNING_SLICE_LOCKED''
            USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP=''UPDATE'' THEN
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM prior_rows point
            JOIN epm.coordinate c ON c.workspace_id=point.workspace_id
            AND c.application_id=point.application_id
            AND c.coordinate_id=point.coordinate_id
            JOIN epm.planning_slice_lock l
            ON l.workspace_id=point.workspace_id
            AND l.application_id=point.application_id
            AND l.status=''Locked''
            AND (l.scope_all OR c.members @> l.scope_members)
        AND NOT (TG_TABLE_NAME IN (''numeric_cell_projection'',''text_cell_projection'',''line_detail_projection'')
            AND epm.fact_reconstruction_allowed(point.workspace_id,point.application_id))
            LIMIT 1) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION ''PLANNING_SLICE_LOCKED''
                USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END ';
ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."reject_locked_fact_write"() OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."reject_policy_draft_overlap"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    AS E'
BEGIN
    PERFORM 1 FROM epm.application_state
      WHERE workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND application_id=NEW.application_id
      FOR UPDATE;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epm.policy_pack_draft existing
      WHERE existing.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
        AND existing.application_id=NEW.application_id
        AND existing.policy_id=NEW.policy_id
        AND (existing.policy_id,existing.version)
            IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.policy_id,NEW.version)
        AND daterange(existing.effective_from,existing.effective_before,''[)'')
            && daterange(NEW.effective_from,NEW.effective_before,''[)'')) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION ''POLICY_EFFECTIVE_RANGE_OVERLAP'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."reject_relationship_cycle"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    AS E'
BEGIN
    \x2d- Serialize competing edge edits in one application. Without this lock,
    \x2d- opposite edges can both pass a visibility-only cycle check.
    PERFORM 1 FROM epm.application_state
        WHERE workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id
          AND application_id = NEW.application_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF NEW.status = ''Active'' AND EXISTS (
        WITH RECURSIVE reachable(member_id) AS (
            SELECT NEW.child_member_id
            UNION
            SELECT r.child_member_id FROM epm.relationship r
            JOIN reachable p ON p.member_id = r.parent_member_id
            WHERE r.workspace_id = NEW.workspace_id
              AND r.application_id = NEW.application_id
              AND r.dimension_id = NEW.dimension_id
              AND r.status = ''Active''
              AND r.relationship_id <> NEW.relationship_id
        )
        SELECT 1 FROM reachable WHERE member_id = NEW.parent_member_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RELATIONSHIP_CYCLE'' USING ERRCODE = ''23514'';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."settle_workspace_reset_jobs"("p_workspace_id" "text") RETURNS TABLE("cancelled_count" bigint, "inspection_count" bigint)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE
    v_status text;
BEGIN
    IF p_workspace_id IS NULL OR p_workspace_id = '''' OR
       p_workspace_id <> current_setting(''epm.workspace_id'', true) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RESET_SCOPE_INVALID'';
    END IF;
    IF current_setting(''transaction_isolation'') <> ''read committed'' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RESET_REQUIRES_READ_COMMITTED'';
    END IF;
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
        hashtextextended(''epm.security.workspace:'' || p_workspace_id,0));
    SELECT status INTO v_status FROM epm.workspace
        WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace_id;
    IF v_status IS DISTINCT FROM ''Maintenance'' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''WORKSPACE_NOT_IN_MAINTENANCE'';
    END IF;
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.job
        WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace_id AND status IN
            (''accepted'',''ready'',''running'',''staged'',''cancel_requested'')) > 1000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION ''RESET_ACTIVE_TARGETS_EXCEED_LIMIT'';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH targets AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.workspace_id,j.application_id,j.job_id,
            EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epm.operation_receipt r
                WHERE r.workspace_id=j.workspace_id
                  AND r.application_id=j.application_id
                  AND r.operation_id=j.job_id) AS has_receipt
        FROM epm.job j WHERE j.workspace_id=p_workspace_id
          AND j.status IN
              (''accepted'',''ready'',''running'',''staged'',''cancel_requested'')
        ORDER BY j.application_id,j.job_id FOR UPDATE OF j
    ), changed AS (
        UPDATE epm.job j SET
            status=CASE WHEN t.has_receipt THEN ''needs_inspection''
                        ELSE ''cancelled'' END,
            claim_generation=j.claim_generation+1,
            claimant=NULL,lease_until=NULL,
            error_code=CASE WHEN t.has_receipt
                THEN ''RECEIPT_REQUIRES_PUBLICATION_REVIEW''
                ELSE ''WORKSPACE_RESET_SETTLEMENT'' END,
            updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
        FROM targets t WHERE j.workspace_id=t.workspace_id
          AND j.application_id=t.application_id AND j.job_id=t.job_id
        RETURNING j.status
    )
    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status=''cancelled'')::bigint,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status=''needs_inspection'')::bigint
    FROM changed;
END ';
ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."settle_workspace_reset_jobs"("p_workspace_id" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."source_batch_upload_manifest_immutable"() RETURNS "trigger"

    RAISE EXCEPTION ''SOURCE_UPLOAD_MANIFEST_REQUIRES_ATTACH''
      USING ERRCODE=''23514'';

      NEW.manifest_request_key,NEW.manifest_origin_kind,
      NEW.manifest_origin_ref,NEW.manifest_schema_version,
      NEW.manifest_schema,NEW.manifest_schema_digest,
      NEW.manifest_content_digest,NEW.manifest_digest,

      OLD.manifest_request_key,OLD.manifest_origin_kind,
      OLD.manifest_origin_ref,OLD.manifest_schema_version,
      OLD.manifest_schema,OLD.manifest_schema_digest,
      OLD.manifest_content_digest,OLD.manifest_digest,
      OLD.manifest_creator_issuer,OLD.manifest_creator_subject_id,
      OLD.manifest_created_at) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''SOURCE_UPLOAD_MANIFEST_IMMUTABLE'' USING ERRCODE=''23514'';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END ';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."source_import_execution_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer, "p_global_limit" integer, "p_workspace_limit" integer, "p_application_limit" integer) RETURNS TABLE("workspace_id" "text", "application_id" "text", "request_id" "text", "claim_generation" bigint)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE candidate record;
BEGIN
 IF p_claimant IS NULL OR length(p_claimant) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
  OR p_lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 600
  OR p_global_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000
  OR p_workspace_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p_global_limit
  OR p_application_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p_workspace_limit THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION ''IMPORT_EXECUTION_CLAIM_INVALID'' USING ERRCODE=''22023'';
 END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(''epm.import.execution.dispatch'',0));
 SELECT r.* INTO candidate FROM epm.source_import_execution r
 JOIN epm.application a ON a.workspace_id=r.workspace_id AND a.application_id=r.application_id
 JOIN epm.application_state s ON s.workspace_id=r.workspace_id AND s.application_id=r.application_id
 JOIN epm.workspace w ON w.workspace_id=r.workspace_id
 LEFT JOIN epm.worker_workspace_dispatch d ON d.workspace_id=r.workspace_id
 WHERE (r.status=''Accepted'' OR
       (r.status IN (''Claimed'',''Publishing'') AND r.lease_until<=clock_timestamp()))
  AND a.status=''Active'' AND w.status=''Active'' AND s.processing_mode=''Active''
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.source_import_execution x
       WHERE x.status IN (''Claimed'',''Publishing'') AND x.lease_until>clock_timestamp())<p_global_limit
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.source_import_execution x
       WHERE x.workspace_id=r.workspace_id AND x.status IN (''Claimed'',''Publishing'')
       AND x.lease_until>clock_timestamp())<p_workspace_limit
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM epm.source_import_execution x
       WHERE x.workspace_id=r.workspace_id AND x.application_id=r.application_id
       AND x.status IN (''Claimed'',''Publishing'') AND x.lease_until>clock_timestamp())<p_application_limit
 ORDER BY d.last_claim_sequence NULLS FIRST,r.created_at,r.workspace_id,
  r.application_id,r.request_id FOR UPDATE OF r SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
 UPDATE epm.source_import_execution r SET status=''Claimed'',
  claim_generation=r.claim_generation+1,claimant=p_claimant,
  lease_until=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>p_lease_seconds),
  error_code=NULL,updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
 WHERE r.workspace_id=candidate.workspace_id AND r.application_id=candidate.application_id
  AND r.request_id=candidate.request_id;
 INSERT INTO epm.worker_workspace_dispatch(workspace_id,last_claim_sequence,claim_count)
 VALUES(candidate.workspace_id,nextval(''epm.worker_dispatch_sequence''),1)
 ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT worker_workspace_dispatch_pkey DO UPDATE SET
  last_claim_sequence=EXCLUDED.last_claim_sequence,
  claim_count=epm.worker_workspace_dispatch.claim_count+1;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT candidate.workspace_id,candidate.application_id,candidate.request_id,
  candidate.claim_generation+1;
END ';

ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."source_import_execution_worker_claim"("p_claimant" "text", "p_lease_seconds" integer, "p_global_limit" integer, "p_workspace_limit" integer, "p_application_limit" integer) OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."transfer_cleanup_claim"("w" "text", "a" "text", "rid" "text", "who" "text", "seconds" integer) RETURNS TABLE("claim_generation" bigint, "batch_limit" integer)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'BEGIN
 IF length(who) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 OR seconds NOT BETWEEN 30 AND 300 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''TRANSFER_CLEANUP_CLAIM_INVALID'';END IF;
 RETURN QUERY UPDATE epm.transfer_cleanup_request r SET status=''Running'',claim_generation=r.claim_generation+1,claimant=who,
 lease_until=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>seconds),updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
 WHERE r.workspace_id=w AND r.application_id=a AND r.request_id=rid AND (r.status=''Accepted'' OR(r.status=''Running'' AND r.lease_until<=clock_timestamp()))
 RETURNING r.claim_generation,r.batch_limit;END';

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."transfer_cleanup_execute"("w" "text", "a" "text", "rid" "text", "who" "text", "generation" bigint) RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog'
    AS E'
DECLARE r epm.transfer_cleanup_request%ROWTYPE;dp integer;dd integer;de integer;
 dpl integer;cert jsonb;dig text;paired text[]:=ARRAY[]::text[];
 orphaned text[]:=ARRAY[]::text[];remaining integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO r FROM epm.transfer_cleanup_request WHERE workspace_id=w
  AND application_id=a AND request_id=rid FOR UPDATE;
 IF r.status=''Completed'' THEN RETURN r.result;END IF;
 IF r.status<>''Running'' OR r.claimant<>who OR r.claim_generation<>generation
  OR r.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION ''TRANSFER_CLEANUP_STALE_WORKER'';END IF;

 \x2d- Both rows are locked before their identities are admitted. SKIP LOCKED is
 \x2d- bounded and deterministic by creation/id; a concurrent retention change
 \x2d- either wins before admission or waits behind these locks.
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(q.artifact_id ORDER BY q.created_at,q.artifact_id),
                         ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO paired
 FROM(SELECT e.artifact_id,e.created_at FROM epm.fact_export_artifact e
  JOIN epm.fact_export_payload p USING(workspace_id,application_id,artifact_id)
  WHERE e.workspace_id=w AND e.application_id=a
   AND e.retention_status<>''held'' AND p.retention_status<>''held''
   AND(e.retention_status=''expired''
       OR e.expires_at_epoch<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint)
   AND(p.retention_status=''expired''
       OR p.expires_at_epoch<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint)
   AND(e.producer_request_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM epm.fact_export_producer_request pr
    WHERE pr.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND pr.application_id=e.application_id
     AND pr.request_id=e.producer_request_id
     AND pr.status IN(''Cancelled'',''Failed'',''Completed'')))
  ORDER BY e.created_at,e.artifact_id LIMIT r.batch_limit
  FOR UPDATE OF e,p SKIP LOCKED)q;

 remaining:=r.batch_limit-cardinality(paired);
 IF remaining>0 THEN
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(q.artifact_id ORDER BY q.created_at,q.artifact_id),
                           ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO orphaned
  FROM(SELECT e.artifact_id,e.created_at FROM epm.fact_export_artifact e
   WHERE e.workspace_id=w AND e.application_id=a
    AND e.retention_status<>''held''
    AND(e.retention_status=''expired''
        OR e.expires_at_epoch<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.fact_export_payload p
     WHERE p.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND p.application_id=e.application_id
      AND p.artifact_id=e.artifact_id)
    AND(e.producer_request_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM epm.fact_export_producer_request pr
     WHERE pr.workspace_id=e.workspace_id
      AND pr.application_id=e.application_id
      AND pr.request_id=e.producer_request_id
      AND pr.status IN(''Cancelled'',''Failed'',''Completed'')))
   ORDER BY e.created_at,e.artifact_id LIMIT remaining
   FOR UPDATE OF e SKIP LOCKED)q;
 END IF;

 DELETE FROM epm.fact_export_payload_chunk c
  WHERE c.workspace_id=w AND c.application_id=a
   AND c.artifact_id=ANY(paired)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.fact_export_artifact e
    JOIN epm.fact_export_payload p USING(workspace_id,application_id,artifact_id)
    WHERE e.workspace_id=c.workspace_id AND e.application_id=c.application_id
     AND e.artifact_id=c.artifact_id AND e.retention_status<>''held''
     AND p.retention_status<>''held''
     AND(e.retention_status=''expired'' OR
       e.expires_at_epoch<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint)
     AND(p.retention_status=''expired'' OR
       p.expires_at_epoch<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint));
 DELETE FROM epm.fact_export_payload p
  WHERE p.workspace_id=w AND p.application_id=a AND p.artifact_id=ANY(paired)
   AND p.retention_status<>''held''
   AND(p.retention_status=''expired'' OR
       p.expires_at_epoch<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.fact_export_artifact e
    WHERE e.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND e.application_id=p.application_id
     AND e.artifact_id=p.artifact_id AND e.retention_status<>''held''
     AND(e.retention_status=''expired'' OR
       e.expires_at_epoch<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint));
 GET DIAGNOSTICS dpl=ROW_COUNT;
 DELETE FROM epm.fact_export_artifact e
  WHERE e.workspace_id=w AND e.application_id=a
   AND e.artifact_id=ANY(paired||orphaned) AND e.retention_status<>''held''
   AND(e.retention_status=''expired'' OR
       e.expires_at_epoch<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.fact_export_payload p
    WHERE p.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND p.application_id=e.application_id
     AND p.artifact_id=e.artifact_id);
 GET DIAGNOSTICS de=ROW_COUNT;

 WITH targets AS(SELECT p.ctid FROM epm.fact_export_producer_request p
  WHERE p.workspace_id=w AND p.application_id=a
   AND p.status IN(''Cancelled'',''Failed'',''Completed'')
   AND p.expires_at_epoch<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.fact_export_artifact e
    WHERE e.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND e.application_id=p.application_id
     AND e.producer_request_id=p.request_id)
  ORDER BY p.created_at LIMIT r.batch_limit),
 pages AS(DELETE FROM epm.fact_export_producer_page p USING targets t,
  epm.fact_export_producer_request q WHERE q.ctid=t.ctid
   AND p.workspace_id=q.workspace_id AND p.application_id=q.application_id
   AND p.request_id=q.request_id),
 deleted AS(DELETE FROM epm.fact_export_producer_request p USING targets t
  WHERE p.ctid=t.ctid RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) INTO dp FROM deleted;
 WITH targets AS(SELECT ctid FROM epm.source_import_diagnostic_artifact
  WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a AND retention_status<>''held''
   AND(retention_status=''expired'' OR
       expires_at_epoch<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())::bigint)
  ORDER BY created_at LIMIT r.batch_limit),
 deleted AS(DELETE FROM epm.source_import_diagnostic_artifact d USING targets t
  WHERE d.ctid=t.ctid RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) INTO dd FROM deleted;
 cert=jsonb_build_object(''requestId'',rid,''deletedProducerRequests'',dp,
  ''deletedDiagnostics'',dd,''deletedExports'',de,''deletedPayloads'',dpl,
  ''batchLimit'',r.batch_limit);
 dig=encode(pg_catalog.sha256(convert_to(cert::text,''UTF8'')),''hex'');
 UPDATE epm.transfer_cleanup_request SET status=''Completed'',claimant=NULL,
  lease_until=NULL,result=cert,updated_at=transaction_timestamp()
 WHERE workspace_id=w AND application_id=a AND request_id=rid
  AND status=''Running'' AND claimant=who AND claim_generation=generation
  AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() RETURNING * INTO r;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''TRANSFER_CLEANUP_STALE_WORKER'';END IF;
 INSERT INTO epm.transfer_cleanup_certificate VALUES(
  w,a,rid,dig,dp,dd,de,dpl,cert,transaction_timestamp());RETURN cert;
END';
ALTER FUNCTION "epm"."transfer_cleanup_execute"("w" "text", "a" "text", "rid" "text", "who" "text", "generation" bigint) OWNER TO "postgres";

CREATE FUNCTION "epm"."validate_planning_seed_lineage"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'pg_catalog', 'epm'
    AS E'
DECLARE source_ok boolean; target_ok boolean;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.workspace_id IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting(''epm.workspace_id'',true)
     OR NEW.application_id IS DISTINCT FROM
        current_setting(''epm.application_id'',true) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''PLANNING_SEED_LINEAGE_SCOPE_INVALID'';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP=''UPDATE'' AND NOT (
      OLD.target_coordinate_id IS NULL
      AND NEW.target_coordinate_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY[''target_coordinate_id'',''target_change_id'',
          ''target_detail_change_id'',''target_committed_revision'']) =
          (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY[''target_coordinate_id'',''target_change_id'',
          ''target_detail_change_id'',''target_committed_revision''])) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''PLANNING_SEED_LINEAGE_IMMUTABLE'';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.source_coordinate_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM epm.coordinate c WHERE c.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
       AND c.application_id=NEW.application_id
       AND c.coordinate_id=NEW.source_coordinate_id
       AND c.series_key=NEW.source_series_key) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''PLANNING_SEED_LINEAGE_SOURCE_COORDINATE_INVALID'';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.target_coordinate_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM epm.coordinate c WHERE c.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
       AND c.application_id=NEW.application_id
       AND c.coordinate_id=NEW.target_coordinate_id
       AND c.series_key=NEW.target_series_key) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION ''PLANNING_SEED_LINEAGE_TARGET_COORDINATE_INVALID'';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.action=''Set'' THEN
    IF NEW.value_family=''Text'' THEN
      SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.text_fact_event e
       WHERE e.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND e.application_id=NEW.application_id
        AND e.coordinate_id=NEW.source_coordinate_id AND e.change_id=NEW.source_change_id
        AND e.committed_revision=NEW.source_committed_revision AND e.present)
       INTO source_ok;
    ELSE
      SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.numeric_fact_event e
       WHERE e.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND e.application_id=NEW.application_id
        AND e.coordinate_id=NEW.source_coordinate_id AND e.change_id=NEW.source_change_id
        AND e.committed_revision=NEW.source_committed_revision AND e.present)
       AND (NEW.value_family<>''Detail'' OR EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM epm.line_detail_event d WHERE d.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
         AND d.application_id=NEW.application_id
         AND d.coordinate_id=NEW.source_coordinate_id
         AND d.change_id=NEW.source_detail_change_id
         AND d.committed_revision=NEW.source_committed_revision AND d.present))
       INTO source_ok;
    END IF;
    IF NOT source_ok THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''PLANNING_SEED_LINEAGE_SOURCE_EVENT_INVALID''; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.target_coordinate_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF NEW.value_family=''Text'' THEN
    SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.text_fact_event e
     WHERE e.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND e.application_id=NEW.application_id
      AND e.coordinate_id=NEW.target_coordinate_id AND e.operation_id=NEW.batch_id
      AND e.change_id=NEW.target_change_id
      AND e.committed_revision=NEW.target_committed_revision
      AND e.kind=CASE WHEN NEW.action=''Set'' THEN ''set'' ELSE ''clear'' END
      AND e.present=(NEW.action=''Set'')) INTO target_ok;
  ELSE
    SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epm.numeric_fact_event e
     WHERE e.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND e.application_id=NEW.application_id
      AND e.coordinate_id=NEW.target_coordinate_id AND e.operation_id=NEW.batch_id
      AND e.change_id=NEW.target_change_id
      AND e.committed_revision=NEW.target_committed_revision
      AND e.kind=CASE WHEN NEW.action=''Set'' THEN ''set'' ELSE ''clear'' END
      AND e.present=(NEW.action=''Set''))
     AND (NEW.value_family<>''Detail'' OR EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM epm.line_detail_event d WHERE d.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id
       AND d.application_id=NEW.application_id
       AND d.coordinate_id=NEW.target_coordinate_id AND d.operation_id=NEW.batch_id
       AND d.change_id=NEW.target_detail_change_id
       AND d.committed_revision=NEW.target_committed_revision
       AND d.present=(NEW.action=''Set''))) INTO target_ok;
  END IF;
  IF NOT target_ok THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''PLANNING_SEED_LINEAGE_TARGET_EVENT_INVALID''; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END ';
